Forward was founded through three groups coming together to build a new home for Americans sick of the partisan fighting, and we'll be at INC '24 to invite more to join us. _Meet your panel of Forward speakers:_
### Andrew Yang
Andrew Yang is a co-founder of the Forward Party. A veteran of U.S. politics, Andrew ran for President and for Mayor of NYC. After those races as a registered Democrat, he saw the dysfunction native to our system and left the party to create a new home for the politically homeless.
### Lt. Gov. Kerry Healey
Lt. Gov. Healey is the Executive Chair of the Forward Party. In her career, she served as the Lt. Governor of Massachusetts under Governor Romney and was the chair of the Massachusetts Republican Party. After witnessing the Republican Party's turn towards extremism, she left and joined Forward to provide better options for the American people.
### Lindsey Williams Drath
Lindsey Williams Drath is the CEO of the Forward party, lending her years of experience as a political operative to our efforts to create a new home for the American. In her time as CEO, she has overseen the development of state parties and the recruitment of high-quality candidates. Her vision and leadership keep us on the Forward path, and she'll be presenting that vision at INC '24.
### Jackie Salit
Jackie Salit is a member of the Forward Party Board of Directors and is a highly respected political innovator and advocate for the rights of independent voters. She serves as the President of IndependentVoting.org, the country’s leading strategy and organizing center for independents, with chapters in 40 states. She also serves as the co-director for the Center for an Independent and Sustainable Democracy at Arizona State University.
### Matt Shinners
Matt has been with Forward since the very beginning. He currently serves as the Chief Strategy and Operations Officer. Prior to Forward, Matt was the Chief of Staff to Andrew Yang's presidential campaign. He's forgotten more about starting a third party than most anyone else has ever learned.

| | I'm still processing the full extent of the absurdity, racism, lies, and the just plain _incomprehensible_ words that Donald Trump spewed from the debate stage this week. But here are a few things that stood out:

* Unprompted, Trump amplified a debunked, utterly xenophobic claim about Haitian immigrants
* Trump yet again denied that he lost the 2020 election and insisted he held zero culpability for what happened on January 6, 2021

clean_body: On the debate stage, Donald Trump reminded us why 81 million Americans fired him. | | | | I'm still processing the full extent of the absurdity, racism, lies, and the just plain incomprehensible words that Donald Trump spewed from the debate stage this week. But here are a few things that stood out: Trump claimed that the American people wanted Roe v. Wade overturned (tell that to the women who've faced medical emergencies in the wake of GOP-run states banning essential care) and refused to say whether he'd veto a national abortion ban Trump delivered a real word salad when confronted with his record of trying to destroy the Affordable Care Act, reaffirmed he wants to destroy it, and when asked for his plan on health care in a second term said "I have concepts of a plan" Unprompted, Trump amplified a debunked, utterly xenophobic claim about Haitian immigrants Trump yet again denied that he lost the 2020 election and insisted he held zero culpability for what happened on January 6, 2021 It was scary. It was infuriating. And yes, it was weird. It also was a reminder of why 81 million Americans fired Donald Trump 4 years ago. It made me more determined than ever to stop Trump and his MAGA cronies at the ballot box again in 53 days. Kamala Harris offered a clear and positive vision for what the future holds should she become president – from a restoration of abortion rights to an expanded child tax credit to further investments in clean energy. But to get this done, she's going to need a Democratic Congress – and I'll be blunt with you: the battle for the Senate remains an exceedingly difficult one for us. We're playing defense across the board, in red states like Montana and Ohio as well as core battleground states like Pennsylvania, Michigan, and Wisconsin. And we have no room for error. = = Moving past the Trump era doesn't stop with keeping him out of the White House; it has to continue with enacting a policy agenda that lifts everyone up and counters the dark vision of America that Trump's movement propagates. I hope you'll join me to make sure we can get it done. body:

---
| | Dear Friends,

After more than a year of incessant campaigning and taking on the establishment during the US Senate campaign, I've taken much needed time off to spend with family since Utah's June Primary. Although I was disappointed in the end results, the campaign was an unmatched experience to meet Utahns across the state, receive donations from over 7000 individuals, earn the endorsements of so many conservative leaders across the country to include President Donald Trump, and be supported by over 130,000 Utah voters and volunteers! I want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone involved.

As our nation enters the general election season, let's discuss next steps:

First, voters have critical decisions to make in the coming months. **I encourage everyone to vote for President Trump and tell your family and friends why you support him.** This close presidential election offers a stark contrast between candidates, with our nation truly at a tipping point. Americans can either choose freedom and prosperity under Trump, or more inflation and illegal immigration under a Harris administration. The choice is clear.

Secondly, many of you have asked what is next for me. Every political campaign is a combination of the candidate, energetic supporters, time-honored principles, and fresh ideas. I talked with thousands of patriotic Americans who share our values and the same dogged determination to defend our liberty. Although I am no longer a candidate, the principles and ideas we championed together on the campaign trail are still in need of support.

**And so,** **I am happy to announce that I have only just begun to fight!**

In the coming weeks, I will be launching a movement to help unify conservatives in Utah and across America. Our God-given freedoms are being attacked and eroded, often by the very government that we the people established to protect us.

We no longer have the luxury to sit on the sidelines, and that's why I am asking you to join me.

Stay tuned. I'll be in touch.
There are great things to come!

Yours in freedom,
Trent Staggs

Tucker Carlson Documents

[WEEKLY UPDATE]

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70149&L=33427&F=T&&hash=55893d19a5372704e7d146e4c468e11fc962a0aae432c92a536cc1a9071e1c82]

JUDICIAL WATCH SUES OVER ATTACK THAT KILLED 13 AMERICAN TROOPS DURING
BIDEN’S AFGHANISTAN PULL-OUT

For three long years, the Biden-Harris Pentagon has been unlawfully
hiding records about the preventable deaths of 13 American servicemen
at the infamous Abbey Gate. This cover-up is disgraceful and is just
one more cruel act against the families of the fallen and other
Americans who want the full truth about the deadly Biden-Harris
Afghanistan debacle.

We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70149&L=33416&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLWFiYnktZ2F0ZS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI1OTgvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=82de1d49fefb0905ccef897c90c3c1f524a0b3af25e836a326cd4089b257463b]
against the U.S. Department of Defense for information on the
communications regarding the deaths of 13 American servicemen at
“Abbey Gate” outside the Kabul airport during the withdrawal from
Afghanistan on August 26, 2021 (_Judicial Watch Inc. vs U.S.
Department of Defense_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70149&L=33416&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLWFiYnktZ2F0ZS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI1OTgvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=82de1d49fefb0905ccef897c90c3c1f524a0b3af25e836a326cd4089b257463b]
(No. 1:24-cv-02598)).

We sued after the Pentagon failed to respond to its September 2, 2021,
request for:

> Any and all records of communications, including emails, internal
> (Pentagon) communications systems, and cables, referencing “Abbey
> Gate” sent to and from the following officials: Secretary of
> Defense Lloyd Austin, Joint Chiefs Chairman Gen. Mark Milley and

We filed the lawsuit [] in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after the State Department failed to comply with a February 7, 2024, FOIA request (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of State [ (No. 1:24-cv-00840)) for: All (2024) emails and diplomatic notes sent to and from the following officials referencing “Tucker Carlson:” Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Deputy Secretary Victoria Nuland, Assistant Secretary James O’Brien, Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary Yuri Kim, Deputy Assistant Secretary Sonata Coulter, Deputy Assistant Secretary Gabriel Escobar, Deputy Assistant Secretary Joshua Huck, Deputy Assistant Secretary Douglas Jones, Deputy Assistant Secretary Jacqueline Ramos, and/or Deputy Assistant Secretary Christopher W. The records we obtained show the State Department has significant interest in the interview and significant interest in hiding its response to the interview. In a nearly fully redacted February 20, 2024, email [] from top State Department official George Pyatt to U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine Bridget Brink and Deputy Assistant Secretary for Europe and European Affairs Christopher W. Smith, Pyatt attaches an article [] by Atlantic Council President and CEO Frederick Kempe titled “Dispatch from Munich: The lessons of appeasement for US lawmakers withholding support for Ukraine,” in which Kempe compares Carlson’s interview of Putin with Adolph Hitler handing out copies of Mein Kampf to newlyweds in Germany. Kempe writes in the article that the Carlson-Hitler comparison is “not such a bizarre vehicle if one considers Carlson’s influence on a Republican minority in the House that is currently standing in the way of approving additional aid for Ukraine.” A lengthy paper [] circulated by email among officials in the State Department’s Bureau of European and Eurasian Affairs (EUR) beginning on February 9, 2024, is almost entirely redacted. Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for European and Eurasian Affairs Yuri Kim then responds in the email thread, “Clear, with edits. FRAUD GRIPS FOOD STAMP PROGRAM, $61.5 MILLION IN STOLEN BENEFITS REPLACED With the price of your groceries shamefully high you certainly won’t appreciate the sloppiness with which your tax dollars are being handled in our fraud-ridden food stamp program. Our Corruption Chronicles blog reports []. Fraud in the government’s food stamp program is so pervasive that the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), the agency that administers it, launched a special system to facilitate the replacement of the welfare benefit when recipients claim it stolen. In the two years since the Biden administration created the program, the government has doled out a hefty $61.5 million to replace pilfered food stamps—rebranded Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) by the Obama administration to eliminate stigma—in 127,290 cases. Keep in mind, this is in addition to the staggering $112.8 billion [.] that Uncle Sam spends to provide 42.1 million with free groceries, according to the latest government figures. The USDA’s SNAP Replacement of Stolen Benefits Dashboard [] reveals that 79% of claims were approved by the agency and that 339,269 fraudulent transactions were identified through approved stolen benefits claims. Recipients in every state in the nation have submitted claims and New York has by far the most food stamp fraud cases—50,678. Maryland is second with 33,509, followed by Illinois (16,369), Texas (11,633), Washington State (4,208), New Jersey (3,630), Arizona (3,541), North Carolina (3,434), Indiana (3,309) and New Mexico (3,027). Three states have reported over 2,000 cases and more than half a dozen have over 1,000. The federal government allows states to replace benefits stolen as far back as October 2022, according to the USDA dashboard. “The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) is aware of increased reports of Electronic Benefit Transfer (EBT) theft due to card skimming, cloning, and similar fraudulent methods,” the agency announced [] in January 2023, revealing that at the end of 2022 President Biden signed a measure that includes a provision for the replacement of stolen food stamp benefits with federal funds. The USDA cites the section of the law that requires it to issue guidance to state agencies and “promulgate regulations to protect and replace SNAP benefits stolen via card skimming, card cloning, and other similar fraudulent methods.” Other similar fraudulent methods may include, but are not limited to, scamming through deceitful phone calls or text messaging that mimics official state agency messaging and phishing. “A theft that resulted from any of these methods would be eligible for replacement,” according to the USDA. Rather than so easily replacing the stolen benefit, perhaps the government should create a system to crack down on the rampant fraud. Besides saving American taxpayers tens of millions of dollars, it seems like a more efficient way to operate. Afterall, the nation’s bloated food stamp program has long been plagued by problems that have fleeced the system out of large sums. A few years ago, the USDA disclosed that it sees over a billion dollars annually in food stamp fraud. Many of the retailers authorized by the government to accept food stamps also engage in illegal practices, the agency has found. A few years ago, nearly 200 people were arrested in Florida for operating a sophisticated ring in which 22,000 fraudulent food stamp transactions totaling $3.7 million [ recorded by a task force of local and federal authorities. In 2016 the feds busted the largest food stamp fraud operation in history, a $13 million scheme [] run by flea market retailers in the largely black and Hispanic areas of south Florida’s Miami-Dade County known as Opa-Locka and Hialeah. The government has failed to mitigate the illicit activities that have long plagued the program and now it is doling out tens of millions of dollars to replace stolen benefits rather than implement a system to prevent it. Just a few weeks ago, a Kentucky news station reported [ thieves have stolen more than $5 million worth of food stamps in the past year from families in Kentucky and Indiana. “Scammers are draining accounts linked to EBT cards,” used by the government to distribute benefits, the story says. In South Carolina a woman recently got busted for fraudulently receiving [ than $28,000 in food stamp benefits. Another woman was also recently arrested in the state for fraud after taking over $12,000 [ food stamps that she did not qualify for. In Delaware and Tennessee, the government recently replaced hundreds of thousands of dollars in stolen food stamps, according to local news reports. The list goes on and on. TEEN BOYS ON HORMONE THERAPY TO INDUCE FEMALE PUBERTY CAN COMPETE IN GIRLS’ SPORTS, OBAMA JUDGE RULES Leftist transgender extremism is a plague of our age – and our courts are not immune. Our Corruption Chronicles_ blog has the latest []. An Obama-appointed federal judge has ruled that two teenage boys in New Hampshire who identify as girls can compete in female school sports teams despite a state law banning it. Earlier this year New Hampshire enacted the Fairness in Women’s Sports Act [] requiring public schools to classify athletic teams based on biological sex at birth and therefore prohibiting transgender students from playing on teams that instead align with their so-called gender identity. Dozens of states have passed similar laws and last year federal legislation [] was introduced to ban individuals of the male sex from participating in programs or activities that are designated for women or girls. The measure, which President Biden has promised to veto, states that “sex shall be recognized based solely on a person’s reproductive biology and genetics at birth.” Under New Hampshire’s law transgender athletes in grades 5-12 must play sports on teams that align with their biological sex rather than gender identity. The measure also requires schools to designate all teams as either girls, boys, or coed, with eligibility determined based on a student’s birth certificate “or other evidence.” The goal is to protect girls from the potential risks and injuries of competing against bigger and stronger transgender athletes, state officials say. When Governor Chris Sununu signed the bill in mid-July he said [] it “ensures fairness and safety in women’s sports by maintaining integrity and competitive balance in athletic competitions.” The Republican governor also pointed out that the law is widely supported throughout the nation with nearly half of all U.S. states taking similar action. With the help of a leftist civil rights group, two boys—15-year-old Parker Tirrell and 14-year-old Iris Turmell—sued [] the Granite State to participate in girls’ sports, asserting that the law discriminates against transgender students in violation of the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution and Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972. The boys allege that the measure denies them equal educational opportunities and singles them out for discrimination solely because they are transgender girls, in violation of federal law. The Fairness in Women’s Sports Act denies them the many educational, social, physical and mental health benefits that come with playing sports and isolates them from friends and teammates, according to their complaint, which explains that each has been diagnosed with gender dysphoria, a health condition characterized by distress resulting from an incongruence between one’s birth sex and gender identity. “As part of their prescribed medical treatment for gender dysphoria, Parker and Iris live and interact with others as girls in every aspect of their lives; they are accepted as girls by their parents, family, schools, peers, teammates, and coaches,” the complaint states, adding that both teens are “receiving puberty-blocking medication and hormone therapy to align their bodies with their female identities and to alleviate the distress of physical characteristics that conflict with their gender identity.” This week Judge Landya McCafferty, appointed to the bench in 2013 by Obama, blocked the enforcement of New Hampshire’s law, ruling that it discriminates against transgender students. The requirement that students stick with their biological sex at birth for sports teams is an obvious legal mechanism to discriminate against transgender girls, according to the judge. “Indeed, transgender girls are the only group whom the Act bars from playing on the team associated with their gender identity,” McCafferty writes in her 48-page order []. The disparate treatment of transgender girls is clear in the statute and the “singling out of transgender females is unequivocally discrimination,” the judge writes. She further notes that the transgender athletes are unlikely to have any physical advantage over their female teammates because both are receiving female hormone therapy. “Neither Parker nor Iris have undergone male puberty,” Judge McCafferty’s order states. “Neither of them will undergo male puberty. Both have received hormone therapy to induce female puberty, and both have developed physiological changes associated with female puberty. It is uncontested that there is no medical justification to preclude Parker and Iris from playing girls’ sports.” The judge also provides a lesson on gender identity and dysphoria, writing that the first is an accepted medical term for a person’s innate sense of gender, which may or may not align with their biological sex or anatomy. Gender dysphoria is a “highly treatable” medical condition resulting from a lack of alignment between one’s birth sex and gender identity that if left untreated may result in anxiety or depression, eating disorders, substance abuse, and even suicide, Judge McCafferty writes. #
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to putALT= a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

Friend,

Because what ABC did to President Trump was nothing short of ELECTION INTERFERENCE.

Sincerely your former customer,

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Take our Critical Race Theory Survey
body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgc92660nprjbvn8gc7o6ctp54lg4buosarucrk8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cpi68or2chh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5u0vh86i25v5u8ek6vv1k42d6holh4de5buk1uo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cpi68or2chh2bs)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zs11rinde9a32mimcp7hp7f1mh3nto5ltlhj0uag_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cpi68or2chh2bs)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2znakncf1viik16ia1dtse1hj3n97m0l7882bpqbo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cpi68or2chh2bs)

subject: Representing Rural Democrats
body:

# Representing Rural Democrats
---
|
---
We are fighting to make a real difference in rural America by representing rural Democrats. Rural communities care deeply about issues that align with Democratic values, though this often goes unnoticed in the media. No Dem Left Behind is committed to ensuring these communities have a strong voice on important issues and bringing their concerns to the national conversation. This country was built on hard work, dedication to one's craft, and a commitment to American values—principles that are still very much alive in rural America today. We cannot turn our backs on these communities now. That's why we are fighting in every battleground state to make a difference. We are working tirelessly in red states, such as Texas, to ensure that the voices of rural America are not drowned out. We believe in America, and we believe in the progress this country can achieve with rural America as a driving force. Together, we can make the change our nation needs.
---
|
---
Thank you for standing with us in this crucial fight. The world of politics can be overwhelming, especially given recent national and global events. In times like these, it's essential to remember that after the storm, clear skies await. With the right strategy and execution, progress for everyone and a stronger America are just around the corner. That's what makes this mission so important. If you can spare a little to support this work, we'd greatly appreciate it...

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b8fc6dc49017410f9fb72f54dc23257a&_e=oblMc9qLS6U4ThwUCr719VcmpmGlgozllwd1K3y8d_mZkTKCE8dDaxDZjqZiF6IRhf6hihNGdAfHp5QBziwJOPnzs1qMlIVdCBupfoC30YqVdoEDab27RAAu19N4H3SS98ZOpqcAS2iVsMspuve2ofv1coC11hGQJO2nIcWH8CCvDC6M20I0aZ0747VE2fk7xIOXu4r0WQCADD-kaEVO08_Rlr65L0970_aLkZptadZuMX5KUkzJPd0ODNAsxSOie083HsUUpmN0-3-yvn1FxUduLwOGa7NubmnEvmo7T9OW0NAJSYZnNfKYs1pzPT-bC9dRGylgEMYxICTAameu5hFl0pvxPhxKRFpYoe1oAlSWN9MLZq1hayeA1kFeXV_b)

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b8fc6dc49017410f9fb72f54dc23257a&_e=oblMc9qLS6U4ThwUCr719VcmpmGlgozllwd1K3y8d_mZkTKCE8dDaxDZjqZiF6IRhf6hihNGdAfHp5QBziwJOPnzs1qMlIVdCBupfoC30YqVdoEDab27RAAu19N4H3SS98ZOpqcAS2iVsMspuve2ofv1coC11hGQJO2nIcWH8CCvDC6M20I0aZ0747VE2fk7xIOXu4r0WQCADD-kaEVO08_Rlr65L0970_aLkZptadYsX8zxK96FNsZh9DIiEzY1tFzW4MkxtG-7mVHhjrhA4FgCQt6suuEl3iUJnpKlG5DmhYwvOpd1xQKX8yqh31EMhyP_8BFFMOJpQ6pT1FXkL6PF6o-AsQXuWIJwUHYXg9JYAZwUbDEK0wi2n1PQ-CyR)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01

Hillsdale College

# [Tell George W. Bush to endorse Kamala Harris and encourage other Republicans to do the same](https://default.salsalabs.org/T49191460-e330-41a3-8453-640a412a3c23/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | George W. Bush is still very popular among Republicans, and his words and actions can still make a difference. [**Which is why he should endorse Kamala Harris, and tell other Republicans to join him in voting for her.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc342a6e3-8735-41f7-914d-53ce05f42066/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Most Trump supporters won't be swayed, because they are essentially following him like a cult leader. But could Bush convince a percent or two to switch? Most definitely. And in a close election, that could make the difference. Huge numbers of prominent Republicans (including Bush's VP, Dick Cheney) have already done so, and Bush needs to as well. But time is short, and Bush needs to act now to make a difference. So he needs to decide -- will he put country over party? Tell him to do it. [**Tell George W. Bush to endorse Kamala Harris and encourage other Republicans to do the same**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T14f91ccf-4e00-4eb1-9d09-60da247cc176/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
I need you to read this

Friend,

I need you **[to act right now to make a huge difference](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e8c44d2f02e749bb9dec4ec6d47848d5&_e=_4B-fZj6Moh37xoboRH0jdHN2PYXg_6LstYjs0z3HtxAxGk2-SFJy4X4_33I4RA31JH3PRYmBtl9fKsdZCnzK3DKd3DvTMFFCa_2Dao88MaM1ZS62gejBGj1l3LWQMU9if41CPFQfPHB0Yz6AJruuv73CyVd-89l_Ii29yUegcsAm_NrG4w_6_zHgs5CAh3rlpnh4FdsEYu2ZbOzJdxkb7HKCfaAKPpMgQRbwo_P8mg9ZzFs7xAGDYNIhMv8zp_uuDtkjiDqPvfOo4h1lHAN19M9C8ssRUDshXlITMT_WMH4UZ-m2C43hiXg-trJdfpIYhTRQZn5qyOk-1Wzic56BQTpWMH6QMq1x_L823iCq9vGj8RCP7QIrHRz45dPrGPFewA4SevcxsT19PDXqCgHomHxya8Me3BTUQs0eBiuXwQ1jfnDVFhL4sUgoGzYhjbf9xTmmZjOqLj0OTiP8swvoFuzexnEd07DWLAzGHMKtPA%3D)** in a critical U.S. Senate race.

My friend and fellow Republican Senator, **[Deb Fischer](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e8c44d2f02e749bb9dec4ec6d47848d5&_e=_4B-fZj6Moh37xoboRH0jdHN2PYXg_6LstYjs0z3HtxAxGk2-SFJy4X4_33I4RA31JH3PRYmBtl9fKsdZCnzK3DKd3DvTMFFCa_2Dao88MaM1ZS62gejBGj1l3LWQMU9if41CPFQfPHB0Yz6AJruuv73CyVd-89l_Ii29yUegcsAm_NrG4w_6_zHgs5CAh3rlpnh4FdsEYu2ZbOzJdxkb7HKCfaAKPpMgQRbwo_P8mg9ZzFs7xAGDYNIhMv8zp_uuDtkjiDqPvfOo4h1lHAN19M9C8ssRUDshXlITMT_WMH4UZ-m2C43hiXg-trJdfpIYhTRQZn5qyOk-1Wzic56BVJfzL-5Db0J4rbzU7WwbSsFxg8HHbnG_k2JX-syNgXxZWMFZCOd-3LYt4xda7yDaYjXTg79-eAn24qDDPmOPTPGCDHJkUjQ0xrxETWj3a-HNdL3LKfAvT7gzzt8k3X0tvujoPitVoYI4lIMvZDcYU8%3D) **of Nebraska, is facing a tough challenge from Kamala Harris, Chuck Schumer, and the rest of the Democrats.

They know that if they defeat her, they'll keep the majority -- **[help us stop that from happening.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e8c44d2f02e749bb9dec4ec6d47848d5&_e=_4B-fZj6Moh37xoboRH0jdHN2PYXg_6LstYjs0z3HtxAxGk2-SFJy4X4_33I4RA31JH3PRYmBtl9fKsdZCnzK3DKd3DvTMFFCa_2Dao88MaM1ZS62gejBGj1l3LWQMU9if41CPFQfPHB0Yz6AJruuv73CyVd-89l_Ii29yUegcsAm_NrG4w_6_zHgs5CAh3rlpnh4FdsEYu2ZbOzJdxkb7HKCfaAKPpMgQRbwo_P8mg9ZzFs7xAGDYNIhMv8zp_uuDtkjiDqPvfOo4h1lHAN19M9C8ssRUDshXlITMT_WMH4UZ-m2C43hiXg-trJdfpIYhTRQZn5qyOk-1Wzic56BcJRz2gw2Lhtq6P6jPOzJIrUw8VQCxCx_WvzmTKH_eD5-orCFFYGFS2OhTweWtxR5RAm03zjxfw80dlKBfj8WzdmO4v4K4sSaO7GjhK350blYCaiYLIu8s_iYtM4E7TdmIWqzrXM-07xM69ExUW0FZI%3D)**

Take it from me, if we're going to make America strong again, we need Deb Fischer back in the Senate. I serve with her on the Armed Services Committee, and I know firsthand how important her leadership is to America's security.

Friend, we can't afford to lose her in the Senate -- _and we can 't afford to lose the majority._

**[Will you help Deb Fischer win in November? Donate any amount here to help her win.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e8c44d2f02e749bb9dec4ec6d47848d5&_e=_4B-fZj6Moh37xoboRH0jdHN2PYXg_6LstYjs0z3HtxAxGk2-SFJy4X4_33I4RA31JH3PRYmBtl9fKsdZCnzK3DKd3DvTMFFCa_2Dao88MaM1ZS62gejBGj1l3LWQMU9if41CPFQfPHB0Yz6AJruuv73CyVd-89l_Ii29yUegcsAm_NrG4w_6_zHgs5CAh3rlpnh4FdsEYu2ZbOzJdxkb7HKCfaAKPpMgQRbwo_P8mg9ZzFs7xAGDYNIhMv8zp_uuDtkjiDqPvfOo4h1lHAN19M9C8ssRUDshXlITMT_WMH4UZ-m2C43hiXg-trJdfpIYhTRQZn5qyOk-1Wzic56BXmZjTF-LBd31KgoJh3QE_pqUvfnho4Q_nN6Wg1lSQsuZ-xclffRksr9LP4PlqG_RW5IIelo3mdZd8u73kLRH0zM5VZD6TdgX-koEvSSGxrxH3iN20W32_y1EgB2O3SD6C68ye2apTpwe8eV8nhohzo%3D)**

_**[Friend, to take back the majority, we need to flip two seats -- and we also have to hold the seats we already have, like Deb's.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e8c44d2f02e749bb9dec4ec6d47848d5&_e=_4B-fZj6Moh37xoboRH0jdHN2PYXg_6LstYjs0z3HtxAxGk2-SFJy4X4_33I4RA31JH3PRYmBtl9fKsdZCnzK3DKd3DvTMFFCa_2Dao88MaM1ZS62gejBGj1l3LWQMU9if41CPFQfPHB0Yz6AJruuv73CyVd-89l_Ii29yUegcsAm_NrG4w_6_zHgs5CAh3rlpnh4FdsEYu2ZbOzJdxkb7HKCfaAKPpMgQRbwo_P8mg9ZzFs7xAGDYNIhMv8zp_uuDtkjiDqPvfOo4h1lHAN19M9C8ssRUDshXlITMT_WMH4UZ-m2C43hiXg-trJdfpIYhTRQZn5qyOk-1Wzic56BSc658JT-KG_tnZZ3iEaOoCmVo7F0Aq6gUUAXpv1ojJ0BWmfQ8MMTZIhFu_IITZPZfFUnlHwByMhCMbO8Pfy90QBGDPZrJ5FtDzfPzZshZJa7VqMkQWrOpwJ_fBFRBnVFSpWZhMXgVsk6mNgSB48j50%3D)**_

But Democrats are outraising Republicans _**[by hundreds of millions nationwide.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e8c44d2f02e749bb9dec4ec6d47848d5&_e=_4B-fZj6Moh37xoboRH0jdHN2PYXg_6LstYjs0z3HtxAxGk2-SFJy4X4_33I4RA31JH3PRYmBtl9fKsdZCnzK3DKd3DvTMFFCa_2Dao88MaM1ZS62gejBGj1l3LWQMU9if41CPFQfPHB0Yz6AJruuv73CyVd-89l_Ii29yUegcsAm_NrG4w_6_zHgs5CAh3rlpnh4FdsEYu2ZbOzJdxkb7HKCfaAKPpMgQRbwo_P8mg9ZzFs7xAGDYNIhMv8zp_uuDtkjiDqPvfOo4h1lHAN19M9C8ssRUDshXlITMT_WMH4UZ-m2C43hiXg-trJdfpIYhTRQZn5qyOk-1Wzic56BWmDP6cOIy1GqQOPn5N8W1T-0b9AKRsPeYqVEO51xgto6dyZd7eydYKhALUNTxg2sQ20OmkLRvkcXkkwLfxORZFxJ5YMtsZQltWXGTzOgOnmtYucxLehFjN1Qg7I1AWqilaHAbnPEQBwM0NSfgpi4NQ%3D)**_

With less than two months until Election Day, it's time for tough conservatives to step up.

**[We must secure the resources we need to break through the Democrats' lies and the liberal media's spin.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e8c44d2f02e749bb9dec4ec6d47848d5&_e=_4B-fZj6Moh37xoboRH0jdHN2PYXg_6LstYjs0z3HtxAxGk2-SFJy4X4_33I4RA31JH3PRYmBtl9fKsdZCnzK3DKd3DvTMFFCa_2Dao88MaM1ZS62gejBGj1l3LWQMU9if41CPFQfPHB0Yz6AJruuv73CyVd-89l_Ii29yUegcsAm_NrG4w_6_zHgs5CAh3rlpnh4FdsEYu2ZbOzJdxkb7HKCfaAKPpMgQRbwo_P8mg9ZzFs7xAGDYNIhMv8zp_uuDtkjiDqPvfOo4h1lHAN19M9C8ssRUDshXlITMT_WMH4UZ-m2C43hiXg-trJdfpIYhTRQZn5qyOk-1Wzic56BZvPjd2NbravYKPYcuj-OgTPx-grU3Ic-zmLJpSTZKCwQYVDvwfLODODZaMr0d6qubBcsqv_sf0oesVROY1IwX8FwLW_19qUmowlxhy-YHrHiQhinyTA75DCPjujL39KYNioZ-fBShdyX4TSmoUKepc%3D)**

# SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 14, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this day in 1901, [President William McKinley died](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnwRsWHJc4GRi6eEvXjhY2R7gWQ2RILL991apj52_4pf_jNt0cJ873d7eSbaFMbmn8oukqNUrACTtvAxGQ6cjqAc4GwCB00WIAs8wULqczeOdnr2cEIjoNGi_aXTq2oADVVaNWaoChN84Yr5bZk5tx0ChQkedWtv6zcG6RQjrKi7Z-KWuXbGztUYV5EzAKGPd97yPXVrbjxwWMLXKV3h2Ss_wTAeO6fHFOdEjPVGUJknOgpXHJMmxllfdnrrE0uZdn9rXbrH_snBLX8yBQ3VfH6bff_r_xsvAdAAD__xLgZTI) of his wounds received during an assassination attempt. Anarchist Leon Czolgosz shot McKinley at the Pan-American Exposition in Buffalo, claiming the president was an "enemy of the people." Russian assets, listening devices, art theft, and spy expulsions: today's edition of _The Flyover_ reads like an espionage thriller. Enjoy! Supporting our sponsors helps support _The Flyover. ## Activists with Russian Ties Convicted
Four activists were convicted of [conspiring to act as illegal Russian agents](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fu6yAUgOGngQ0LDsQ2A8NdsuWuHS0Mx85pCUSGGPXtq2bu_ku_vo_bcvOUKO___QNd28riQ6MTFyuUEWAWw6PbEAE1R6cmGDWANsDvTmMIWtt51TPAKNUGGC_e4gigLuMaOTmQYKRVRkk5wTRor3WUYY3oVzMpw4zESK0cw2eh3O64pe9y4jGE8uDJ3Vt7Vqb_MbgyuPbeh4y9dsSv34DB9XjVSj4Lv2NuIpRcn3RQ3oXfPeXaxKuKN4dqq0LZC9h55oeLz04pUR0nZuT-8JTex_a3_3TwEwAA___J-15I) within the United States, the Department of Justice announced on Thursday. According to prosecutors, Omali Yeshitela, Penny Hess, Jesse Nevel, all of St. Louis, and Augustus C. Romain Jr. of Atlanta [received money and support](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvozAQhH-N6YzsXV-AwsU1dLkmOl2JjL3A3nNwZDtE_PunpH7dSDPFfN-_63R1HHlf_7g72bqkyfnKB02D1EaCmUwT7EIEhA1Z3cEFAdBAs9m5I1ShR6eHRYVfvg-LW2jwgBCCw6VhCwqMGrTRSnXQtegQg_JzIDebThthFAWuKbf_E-91oyWe6aDc-nRvot1qfRSBvwWMAkY3-51epV3TuxYw_r0JGF-c6VZTPgWMc3T-S2Zet1rkB4NLLdKn_WBfKbxTeXB2_pTrk2M9P6t9lflZCrtdao0XNH2PTbbh8eIYuVw6YdR6dxw_t-rPkg4L3wEAAP__f-9sRg) from a Moscow-based organization for a number of actions in the US between 2015 and 2022. They were acquitted on the more serious charges of acting as foreign agents. The four face [potential imprisonment](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7uOgzAQAL_G7oLW6w0mhYtr6HLtlciPBRwZjMAC3d-fcnW6kUYaaX6ew9OlnNbp2y1s61gGF2o6eXjcFN2QBpLRjszIWrJVBluNqAnlbIG1uhMHNbLywcd7Rx14BcCIutNGJouABA9FCsCgabTTOkLwkZ0no0gQcEy17M2rpLXOPObfcvLehLLIbOdat0PoL4G9wP66rsb78HYC-5WvQ2Dv9ppC5jeGFmnbJkWvrcjdxu1KOaejNYJgWlzK_9X6-fG0-BcAAP__SD9StQ) of up to five years. As of Thursday, no sentencing date was set.
## Wisconsin's Universities Adopt Neutrality Policy
Wisconsin's 13-school university system [announced an immediate neutrality policy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGP4yAQRn-N3RHBMIG4oLgmXa690sIwJHMiYBliK_vrV9l6y0-f9PT0_t3mm-fM5f7XP8n1VGcfOu80T0KhAJxxjC4RAemRnLJgNIBGGB8uULrYM6EO9qKDMcpMyaSAxqYFUS4jO5CAclKopLRgT9prHWVYIvkFrcIBJUXudTv9r1z6g1J-1522U6jPMbtH72sb9J8BrgNc_VroaJ_rM7bOIdMA11fhnbbGnamJmsTBLdTSuIid6Vg_XFHo1TefxVozh7e4-y8vVKLJBLXoGH2cbPRGpos6S7lMpCilcXNxPThnbsYOKO9Pz_lHrP-eaXfwHQAA__-sw2vS) on Friday, limiting officials' public statements to operational matters while maintaining impartial viewpoints. The new policy is an outgrowth of [UW-Milwaukee's anti-Israel protest deal](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFv8yAUAH8N3rDgwWecgeFbvKVLVHW0CDw7ryJgAbHlf1-lc-cb7nRf1_nqKFJaP9wTbVvy7HyjHecLl5qDnnUX7IIIqDq00sCgAJSG7mERnZDD6EdnRhWWi0FhFi_8v6Ck8Qt0ZEGAFheppRAGTK-cUkH4e0B310ZqpgUGarn035lSe-ASz7xj6X1-dtE-WtsqU_8ZTAwmd_cJj9qv-Y0ZTJ83BtNBBW8tl5PB9Eq0Y6nUCCs_qPqcKiXuQt4a3wmP7W3hCV-tuMi3HMmf3OcYcUUe0QUslUuphmHQo-6KDdtBMVIdDNNifTqKv2nt71G7hZ8AAAD___BqbZA) where Chancellor Mark Mone agreed to call for a cease-fire in Gaza and discuss cutting ties with Israeli companies. UW System President Rothman and Jewish groups criticized Chancellor Mone's deal with anti-Israel protesters, with Rothman calling for campus neutrality and consequences for actions. The new [policy exempts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD_vpCAUAD8Ndhh84L-C4hq7vfZKg_DQd0EwwGr221_26l89xWTmz2t9GQoU99_mRF19Wo2tdOM6805xUKtqnPaIgLJB3Y0wSACpoDm0tVsve5hmAWaWdpicQesnNw8eZqFEQxoEKDF3qhNihLGVRkon7ObQbGrsFFMCHdWU27-JYj3Qh0-6Mbc2nU3QR61XYfIXg4XB8jxPe8Q94lO-nMFSqqnIYHlHujEXqoSFJ88fKjbFQpEbl67Kb8Ln-gp4xHfNJvArBbIf7lPmNoWAO_KAxmEuDBaTK9mA67b1_SjAczlMM-_HQfLNKsslmG2azNShF-1Rz9Bk7a6HQqAyjEyJ_TQU_jfUn4_eGv4FAAD__3Veelo) faculty and staff when teaching or sharing field-related expertise but cautions against using university channels to avoid implying institutional positions. Personal statements on non-university platforms are also exempt.
## FDA Approves Apple's Hearing Aid
The FDA has approved software enabling Apple's latest AirPods Pro model to [function as hearing aids](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQAL8GOixYOPtcULyG7l6b0lrDct6IM5aN7OTvo0udeqQZzcdjeiAXXp__8UW-5TphbHzSNCrjFLjJyeQzEZCV5M0AvQWwDuTis8mG4nyjSPdbvufYE_Zm1tn1MOfbKNmDBqdH44zWAwydRWuTjnMinN1gnHCaEre6d5-V17ZQLt_1pL2L9SWLX1rbDmH_CQgCwnVdHX5xPd5UQHi7BQQ9CggGBIScUC2EO69PlejkSKq2qHDbCinkfavpkLtP28Wl8NEPwunnC7n85trf86eHnwAAAP__fd1bvg). Apple's new Hearing Aid Feature, [available in October](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQhX-N2UD23YFh8BCpsrok6tYROfERrnLiCFxQ_31F587vSe993-d5PAdJ8rxfwoNdmfIYbkU2HofaUA00UhXdxAyMFTtjoUMAJKhm11OHRFdou3Ygw9j3FnQXoO1pmjSGShxoID0YMlpbsA0GxKhv18jhStaQIs1RSl6aryzPMvOUfvLGS3PLjyq5uZTXqvCkwCvw-7433y85MgX-nUMq83jhfVXgjx0FXg8KvEEF3r-d6pMsHzmu9cxhkee9DhKPrjV4YIDue2oV-Gpx8bVLSrJ2VpG-P4Kkvwflfx-bg98AAAD__8MHXIY), will turn AirPods Pro 2 and compatible earbuds into hearing aids when used with iOS 18 devices. It's the first FDA-authorized software to convert consumer earbuds into over-the-counter hearing aids. Apple says users [can create personalized hearing profiles](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQhX-N2UD23YFh8BCpsrok6tYROfERrnLiCFxQ_31F587vSe993-d5PAdJ8rxfwoNdmfIYbkU2HofaUA00UhXdxAyMFTtjoUMAJKhm11OHRFdou3Ygw9j3FnQXoO1pmjSGShxoID0YMlpbsA0GxKhv18jhStaQIs1RSl6aryzPMvOUfvLGS3PLjyq5uZTXqvCkwCvw-7433y85MgX-nUMq83jhfVXgjx0FXg8KvEEF3r-d6pMsHzmu9cxhkee9DhKPrjV4YIDue2oV-Gpx8bVLSrJ2VpG-P4Kkvwflfx-bg98AAAD__8MHXIY) using iPhones and the new AirPods Pro, transforming the earbuds into clinical-grade hearing aids. According to the FDA, [more than 30 million American](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FugzAQQL8GNiPf-QJl8NAlW7p2RAc-4CpjI7CI8vdVOnd-T3p634_hwRo1LV-8iS9zHngqesnQGyCDNFAd_CyC4mrx0GHrEB1hvfoW23a6jdbamT56kHbkHmBECEAgbq7Vo0WyPRBY22HXOHYu2GkMwiN1QBVZCVry0fxkTWWVOb7yJUcz5a2Ofi1lPyv3WeG9wvusidMkzYvXnN9Ghfckz_ONAhve9yNfcppcJrMKH5oWwxoMdOjwBkTNWrZYHz7sT41Rz7aryC4ba_zrlf_vL4-_AQAA__80vluH) adults have some degree of hearing loss.

## Three Injured in Dallas High-Rise Shooting
Three people, including a child, [sustained gunshot injuries](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOhCAURb8GOg08EKWg2IZutt3SPOE5kuAwEaKzf7-Z6be9Nycn5-c23zDl9Lh_406uvdYyY2jppNl2UnegZ82jW0S0kpOTIxgljRo135yhVYPFdUJhSMdpHFaz4DJMcsCog-LJgQAtrNRSDEbJXimUVtkJhJBBxsi0oJhaOfq2UaMX1jX_lpOOPpSdZ7e19qxMfTHwDPx1XX1Y6oOu-v4Z-A_CwL8nBr5upbT0uHcRc8bahbLvdATqajuIGgPPDxefV8o5VTMyLe47pvyRtX_aTwd_AQAA__95bF0E) at a Dallas high-rise apartment Thursday. One victim emerged from the building holding his stomach and asking for help. Police swarmed the area but were unable to detain the shooter. No suspect has been named, and the [shooter remains at large](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2SpCAUQOGnwQwLLvhDQLAJWW-6oYVyFbYQLKDb7refmsknPsmp799jedgQQzr-2hN1e-95sVsLL1wU5ZKCXGTn9Mqc4h1qPsEo-Cgm2Xmtph0V4DrNDHAYYBZuVLPYGQqAcZ26oIGBZIpLzoZR8F4Iy5VQMzDGN-4ckQxdaLn0zWPDt617_OQXln7LZxe1b-2qRPwhYAiY-777tG5uv78zAZPwrgRMzJuNBEzzBZFemK-INKT_z4KOhkSrz7mFdFDbqLMx2kp9ODwtoSK1ly3txNRozc-yYaXVfggYMUoJgyJguqLddYcYQx0nItlx2hB_BtsvXi8NXwEAAP__eeVtxg). Sources indicate the shooting arose from a dispute and was not a random attack. The victims' conditions haven't been released, but [full recoveries are expected](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FuhSAUQL8GNg33glgGhi5ur2tHg3B5kuDDCFH7983r3u0MJzk534_54VJOr-eX28i2O5bZ-ZZOmk0HqkM1Kx7sIoIBThZG1BK0HBVfLRJoj9F556OTUdKw6MUMpIKUYojAk0WBShhQIAYtoZfSgZHmA4UADyEwJSikVo6-rdTodjXmn3LS0fuy8WzX1vbK5CfDieF0XVcfy61edNW3wHB6I8MpuJxd7faSk6fOl22jw1NX20HU-GHDfqWcU9UjU-K5uZT_Au2f39PibwAAAP__b9lZSg).

Peter, even if Donald Trump loses, the extreme principles laid out in Project 2025 will live on in the states. The extremist plan is already taking hold in states across the country, and its adherents will work to keep the plan marching forward. **Let’s take a look at just how Project 2025’s anti-democracy, anti-freedom agenda is being implemented by MAGA Republicans in Arkansas, right now: **
* This November, voters will _not_ get the chance to vote on an abortion rights ballot initiative.
* The far-right secretary of state rejected the abortion rights team’s ballot petition signatures, saying organizers didn’t correctly submit a paid canvasser training certification.
* In a 4-3 decision, the state supreme court said that the secretary of state unequally applied laws around paid canvassers, but the justices refused to check that and right the wrong.
* In the minority dissent, one justice said “the majority has succeeded in its efforts to change the law in order to deprive the voters of the opportunity to vote on this issue, which is not the proper role of this court.”
* MAGA Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders said she’s “proud” that she built the conservative court majority that ushered this decision through.

Project 2025 is a blueprint to dismantle our rights and overrule the will of the people. Arkansas is just one state where pieces of that plan are already being rolled out, and **health care and reproductive rights for everyone in Arkansas will suffer as a result. And we are seeing this across the country, with 22 states enacting abortion bans since _Roe_ was overturned.** [**Your gift today is a commitment to elect candidates who will hold the line for our freedoms and democracy. That's it! No funky chemicals. No artificial gunk. The only things in your food are food. Now, you may be wondering how we guarantee such a long shelf life for canned foods. It comes from our special, old-fashioned retort canning process. We use small-batch retorts to cook your meat right inside the can. That means 2 important things. First, your meat is slow cooked, so it retains all its natural juices and flavor. And it's ready to go right out of the can. And second, it kills off any germs in the can that might harm the shelf life. Sometimes, the old-fashioned way is the right way. And guess what? This is all done right here in the US of A. Our survival meats are home raised here in the states. So you know exactly where your food comes from. And as a family-owned, American business, we take a lot of pride in that. Look friend, there's no better time to claim your Ultimate Meat Survival Food Kit than now. Meat is one of the first things to go in a crisis. Wildfires, hurricanes, cyberattacks or something else. And the last thing I want for you is to miss out. Or worse, leave you and your family stuck with a subpar protein option. Here at 4Patriots, our mission is to champion freedom and self-reliance for all Americans. And with everything going on in the world, it's clear that survival food is no longer a luxury. It's a necessity. Ask anyone who's lived through a crisis. There's no warning. You won't see a big billboard that says "emergency coming in 5 days! Stock up before then." Disasters come out of nowhere. And if you aren't prepared when it hits, it's too late. I mean, just imagine standing in line at your local supermarket. Shelves picked bare. And the people who didn't prepare scrambling and hoarding what little food they can find. All while you pray there's a sliver of meat left for you and your family. This doesn't have to be you, friend. You can choose a different path. When storms come knocking at your door, you can stay safely inside with your loved ones. You'll feel great knowing you and your family have delicious shelf-stable meat ready to go. And trust me, the peace of mind that comes with that, feels incredible. To your survival, Frank Bates Patriot Headquarters P.S. Thanks to your support, we are able to provide support to important charities that help American veterans and their families. Charities like Fisher House, A Soldier's Child Foundation, Team Rubicon and Operation Homefront. More Raving Customer Reviews! Joseph L. "I buy a lot of stuff at Wal-mart, but this is gonna out-do the stuff on Wal-mart shelves, which contains all kinds of preservatives. I did a taste test even though I've never found a bad product from 4Patriots. Hamburger Helper can kiss my butt - this stuff here is good! (Maybe not as good as my wife's cooking.) This is a good buy." Danielle M. 4Patriots Employee "I was surprised at how good everything in the Ultimate Meat Medley really was. As an avid cook, I have high standards; I worried it might be salty or dried out. What I discovered was moist chicken and turkey that shreds easily for the fastest chicken salad ever or super fast BBQ turkey sammies. The pork and beef are in perfect chucks for adding to stews or burritos. Even the ground beef, which I could not envision being delicious, tasted just like the ground beef I typically brown and drain, but in zero time! This box is definitely going to become my "oh shoot, I forgot to thaw a meat" solution for everyday and I'll have to grab more to store." Michael M. "My family won't be asking, "where's the meat when disaster comes." I bought the Meat Medley so we have beef, pork, chicken, turkey and ground beef to supplement our food stock. I was very pleasantly surprised at the amount of meat at the price I paid. My order arrived quickly and now I know I'll have the right answer when my family ask "where’s the meat"." Ernest K. ---
Peter, it’s Cecile Richards. You know the stakes of this election all too well.
**Women’s rights are under relentless attack** — especially the right for women to make their own decisions about whether to have an abortion or seek reproductive health care.
Make no mistake: If Republicans hold the House, if they retake the Senate, and if Trump wins, _**they will do everything they can to sign a national abortion ban into law**_. That’s the truth, but we are not powerless. And that’s why** _I am doing whatever it takes to make sure this does not happen_**. That’s why I am writing to you today.
**Because in Arizona, abortion is quite literally on the ballot** — when voters go to the polls in Arizona this November they will be able to vote on a ballot measure to protect the right to choose an abortion, alongside voting in support of champions like Ruben Gallego.
Winning will not be easy. Arizona is one of the most closely watched states in the country, and for good reason. Polls show the state a dead heat. **Ruben Gallego is in a neck-and-neck race with his opponent, anti-abortion crusader Kari Lake, with a seat in the U.S. Senate on the line.** In her last campaign she lost by less than 20,000 votes — less than 1% of all votes cast.
**If Ruben wins in Arizona, it is all the more likely that this pro-choice ballot measure will pass.** It’s all the more likely that we pick up a few seats in the House, too. And it’s almost certain that we’ll be able to defeat Donald Trump and elect Kamala Harris.
For our children, for our grandchildren, **Ruben must be successful in Arizona**. I don’t even want to consider the alternative.
So, if you’ve heard enough, I have a humble request:
[**Please, make a $5 donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign in Arizona. Every campaign is difficult, but Arizona will be one of, if not the closest, states in the country. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Move Up, Mississippi! It’s time for school choice in our state
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/taxreform-11573075?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **Education is the number one thing we need to improve in Mississippi.**

That’s why MCPP just launched “Move Up, Mississippi”, a campaign aimed at changing our education system for the better.
---
|
---
Mississippi education is only going to improve if we accept the truth about how things really are:
* **4 in 10 fourth graders would struggle to read this sentence.** That’s right. 4 in 10 fourth graders fail to attain the __basic__ reading standard in 2022.
* 7 in 10 fourth grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient in reading in 2022.
* 8 in 10 eighth grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient in math in 2022.

| |
---
**Rather than getting better, the rate of chronic absenteeism in Mississippi schools has got worse.**

In 2022-23, over 100,000 students regularly skipped school, up from 70,000 in 2016-17.
---
| _**So, what’s the solution?**_

**_What we need is school choice._** Mississippi is now surrounded by states that have school choice. It is transforming education for the better. Let’s not get left behind.....
---
|
---
**School Choice would mean every family gets to decide where their share of the state education budget is spent.** It would mean that the values being taught in your child’s classroom would have to align with the values of Mississippi families.

**To find out what school choice would mean for you and your family, have [_a look here._](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=7f932191fe&e=5703353baa)**

**Arkansas, Louisiana and Alabama have done more to improve education in 12 months than Mississippi has achieved in 12 years.** Sign up and join our movement if you believe it is time to change that!
|
---
| Have a great weekend!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=854401685d&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")

Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: Free speech is no joke
body:
We’re not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. | | | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6312ae7a17434fb09bc8de7930434418&_e=q93-5XCD5U5VjZQ57Xg414ntF7V-CWDDSWmT9uGdwWFkO9cIsZEgMoTN4hlDEoXjEgsW0N0RQ_eTjKeB_uj6L8OqkhO0MUs0AEZfrDmi6s2WRmkLnVmHW6pTSol_cB_dydw9wiPsHu4rwGBqc4YijZm3lMkQwSuh6OA2zljHaKaipmR3r6Lvq3mkleF2BFs213K9WY7T1KMKOHY5li0ypKCvoQVlwJjvNtYFEh407HYVx5CR3mM5qOXNO8m7Q3jaFBMSROpt47yqKTf2kGlYmg%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Peter, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6312ae7a17434fb09bc8de7930434418&_e=q93-5XCD5U5VjZQ57Xg414ntF7V-CWDDSWmT9uGdwWFkO9cIsZEgMoTN4hlDEoXjEgsW0N0RQ_eTjKeB_uj6L8OqkhO0MUs0AEZfrDmi6s2WRmkLnVmHW6pTSol_cB_dyuUmuRgG9sb4yzSgP3i7YQ1T8IgGeEtiWiADj5KSXQB7zcLuVbmz_HULqhvXq-n-WHQNvfaet4Xxz_wXKVxfvAlE3f4y9tCJxbKK9WfXEClGz0xYBMoP41dd0Nw4doQ7bLZBu5jvNEV5KcUaUXqMmg%3D%3D)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6312ae7a17434fb09bc8de7930434418&_e=q93-5XCD5U5VjZQ57Xg414ntF7V-CWDDSWmT9uGdwWFkO9cIsZEgMoTN4hlDEoXjEgsW0N0RQ_eTjKeB_uj6L8OqkhO0MUs0AEZfrDmi6s2WRmkLnVmHW6pTSol_cB_d6VrWeZ9UcFCIaK4bopRKF4ywEGbKXNYJwSPxzvbWaGsD3XFGk-hUYh7GtxqnfjG7q4P_uKmr1_YgkdfiEYohBXnQWmt4txgHZYUvxOYUSNquU76Atdx4dY0Rhi27BWdeJwUVzdDX9SYMCfFvaQnbVA%3D%3D)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6312ae7a17434fb09bc8de7930434418&_e=q93-5XCD5U5VjZQ57Xg414ntF7V-CWDDSWmT9uGdwWFkO9cIsZEgMoTN4hlDEoXjEgsW0N0RQ_eTjKeB_uj6L8OqkhO0MUs0AEZfrDmi6s2WRmkLnVmHW6pTSol_cB_dgA3OjdoTsF_o20p642KGKPlRjhoD22brO9T7G2vEbdLxK345P5QoenVdNswUKYfYDtBCYurbma5Dv06QoHyFFU2KygMs6T8glTjzxQWEl_S9jVv9JNvkQd7NsyFTYvR7S8kpeetvujLQ3ep0Mpl1ow%3D%3D)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6312ae7a17434fb09bc8de7930434418&_e=q93-5XCD5U5VjZQ57Xg414ntF7V-CWDDSWmT9uGdwWFkO9cIsZEgMoTN4hlDEoXjEgsW0N0RQ_eTjKeB_uj6L8OqkhO0MUs0AEZfrDmi6s2WRmkLnVmHW6pTSol_cB_dVUAQjsgXkLDu8lyesioormn7qlpfAOw0-PRFD97s2VC84fiCY9eCi6fN_f1dr6cQHBnICjnyruukJ8FYjNdoBXEsfSokD1ihrJENjK5r8TmjIXB3u5jyGGHo7dtBzqXd0CfCEIkf8XRv2kl-mwGu-Q%3D%3D)
---
They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6312ae7a17434fb09bc8de7930434418&_e=q93-5XCD5U5VjZQ57Xg414ntF7V-CWDDSWmT9uGdwWFkO9cIsZEgMoTN4hlDEoXjEgsW0N0RQ_eTjKeB_uj6L8OqkhO0MUs0AEZfrDmi6s2WRmkLnVmHW6pTSol_cB_drO-B0esLqKbYcw_Rr_OSxdgdFgcOMW4cuKpDnyg_Hp6R4pSvVCys9WXIKoNG_UC7-XFyUe1tj5smQ4qmlmRdFhS1LOfSVTPBWSUyJq0BfbX9X08kDtf-AHF5C5eKMCBqREnKkANIjI-ELeTy7UHhqw%3D%3D)** Thanks for considering standing with us. We'll stand with you, too.

Do you remember the pre-Trump era?

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92792643/498330806/-793144256?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZWQwYTYwZC05YjcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pC6FhCn_EMdtZ3WEL1ZP2sOeRnj9msiTrdpfz0LbS9k=&emci=44f139c4-f271-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=6ed0a60d-9b72-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=15759664)
---
Hey Derek, Remember when politics wasn’t so gloomy? When the Republican Party wasn’t led by Donald Trump and wasn’t blinded with hate? It’s been a while, but we haven’t forgotten those times. **The Democratic Party is bringing that joy back.** While Kamala Harris and Tim Walz travel the country charming voters with their kindness and relating to hard-working Americans, Donald Trump is attending fundraisers held by (actual) billionaires promising to cut their taxes. _And don’t get us started on J.D. Vance._ There’s no room for hatred in Virginia, Derek. With Election Day just weeks away, the 2024 campaign is hurtling toward a nail-biting finish. The stakes couldn't be higher for Democrats defending the White House and crucial congressional seats in battleground states. Here's what our latest research reveals:
**Presidential Race Tightens**
Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump are locked in a razor-thin battle across key battleground states.
Michigan, Pennsylvania, and Georgia are pivotal, with Harris gaining momentum in some areas but struggling in others. In Michigan, Trump narrowly leads, with voters divided on who can best manage the economy and foreign affairs. However, Harris holds a slight edge in Pennsylvania, where voter concerns over affordability remain front and center.
Georgia is emerging as another hotly contested state, with Harris making inroads among Black voters but still trailing Trump.

Message: To Gen Z Republicans

Long Form Message for long social posts or for print

Hey Gen Z! This election isn’t just another chance to vote—it’s an opportunity to shape your future. By voting early, you’re taking control of your voice and giving yourself the best shot at making sure your vote is counted without last-minute stress.

The American Dream is alive and evolving, and it’s up to you to decide how it looks. By voting early, you’re ensuring that your generation's values of freedom, opportunity, and meritocracy are protected. Your vote helps ensure that the country continues to provide opportunities for success, hard work, and innovation.

Don’t wait for election day to make a difference—secure your voice, secure your future, and protect the American Dream. Vote early, vote for your future.

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

Hey, Gen Z! This election is your chance to shape the future. Vote early to make sure your voice is heard and stress-free. Protect freedom, opportunity, and the American Dream. Don’t wait—vote early and secure your future!

** Message: It’s Important to get All Republicans to the Polls:
------------------------------------------------------------

Long Form Message for long social posts or for print

We understand the sentiment surrounding voting by mail and the preference for showing up on Election Day—it’s part of the tradition for many Republicans. But we have to face the reality: times have changed, and we need to embrace every tool available to us. If we don’t, the Democrats will, and we’ll be left behind.

While Election Day voting remains essential, we can’t afford to overlook absentee voting or early voting. These options are attractive to a lot of people and allow us to secure votes well ahead of the rush. The truth is, the more we focus on voting early, the better chance we have of turning out Republican voters and ensuring our voices are heard.

It’s time to focus on encouraging people to vote early and vote Republican. Doing so will increase turnout and give us the strategic advantage we need to win. Let’s embrace the future and use every opportunity to strengthen our movement!

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

Republicans love Election Day, but times have changed. We must embrace early and absentee voting to stay competitive. If we don’t, Democrats will—and we’ll be left behind. Let’s focus on voting early to secure our voices and strengthen our movement. Vote early, vote Republican!

** Message: You are a reliable voter; vote early and bank the
------------------------------------------------------------

** vote (Hard Republican)
------------------------------------------------------------

**
------------------------------------------------------------

Long Form Message for Social posts or for print

Your consistent participation as a reliable voter is essential to shaping the direction of our nation. By voting early, you’re securing your vote and helping the party concentrate resources on those who have yet to cast their ballot.

When you ‘bank’ your vote early, you free up valuable time and effort for the party to focus on turning out less reliable voters. It’s a strategic move that maximizes the effectiveness of every vote and strengthens our chances of success. Early voting is how to lock in your support and let the team rally the rest.

Help us build momentum and stay ahead—vote early, bank your vote, and empower the party to bring more voters to the polls. Your early vote is key to securing victory!

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

As a reliable voter, voting early secures your vote and helps the party focus on turning out others. By banking your vote, you free up resources and strengthen our chances of success. Vote early and empower the team to win!

** Message: You are an older voter; vote early and bank the vote
------------------------------------------------------------

Long Form Message for Social posts or for print

As grandparents and pillars of your family, your vote isn’t just about today—it’s about the legacy you leave for your children and grandchildren. Voting early ensures that your voice is heard and your vote is counted without the worry of last-minute complications that could prevent you from making it to the polls.

Life can be unpredictable, especially as election day approaches. Voting early gives you the peace of mind that your contribution to the future is secure, no matter what. By casting your ballot ahead of time, you’re ensuring that your values, vision for a strong America, and commitment to the next generation will be counted.

Don’t wait until the last minute. Vote early, protect your vote, and secure your legacy for those you love.

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

As grandparents and elder community members, your vote is about your legacy. Voting early ensures your voice is heard without last-minute worries. Secure your future and values by voting early and protecting what matters to your family!

** Message: Low Propensity (Weak) Republicans
------------------------------------------------------------

Long Form Message for Social posts or for print

Your voice matters—and voting is the only way to ensure it’s heard. By voting early, you guarantee that your vote counts without the risk of waiting until the last minute when things can come up. Life gets busy, but casting your vote early ensures that your voice is counted, no matter what.

This election is your chance to shape the future. Don’t leave it to chance—voting early is the easiest way to make sure your voice is part of the conversation. Be counted, make your vote matter, and help build the future you want to see.

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

Your voice matters! Nothing changes if you stay home!

Vote early to make sure it’s counted without last-minute issues. Don’t leave it to chance—vote early and help shape the future you want to see! Nothing changes if you stay home!

| [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92797459/498347386/1929658185?refcode=em_fl_eha_20240914_fr_apachers_cand_mf_30da_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTZmZjRkNS05ZTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lKVEI2bMnLtj7DeaF5afpZ03WHZMG2BxRys-zEtjrMM=)
---
Climbing into the cockpit of my Apache helicopter and strapping myself in was the greatest adrenaline rush of my life. (The second was announcing I was running for Congress.) | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92797460/498347387/1929658185?refcode=em_fl_eha_20240914_fr_apachers_cand_mf_30da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTZmZjRkNS05ZTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lKVEI2bMnLtj7DeaF5afpZ03WHZMG2BxRys-zEtjrMM=)
---
See, the Apache helicopters are basically airborne tanks. And our primary job as pilots was to provide cover for troops on the ground. So when I'd get the call to fly out, I'd race out to the Apache, put on my helmet, clip into my seat, and turn on the 48-foot rotor blades – all with the thought, **"I'm going to protect my people."**
And then off we'd fly.
That mentality, of being a protector, has never left me. And it's why I'm running for Congress – because I won't sit by when I see working families, veterans, women, LGBTQ+ folks, or anyone else who calls this country home being attacked.
**But this time, instead of jumping into an Apache helicopter to protect my people, I'm jumping into the race to represent Pennsylvania's First Congressional District.**
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92797461/498347388/1929658185?refcode=em_fl_eha_20240914_fr_apachers_cand_mf_30da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTZmZjRkNS05ZTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lKVEI2bMnLtj7DeaF5afpZ03WHZMG2BxRys-zEtjrMM=)
---
Of course, just like how nothing in the Army gets done alone, neither does running for office. It takes a whole team of people – but instead of co-pilots and platoons it's a campaign manager, volunteers, and yes, donors.
**[That's why, as much as I hate asking for money, I'm asking you to pitch in $10 to this campaign. I'm committed to protecting the people of PA-01 in Congress, but I can only get there with your support.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92797462/498347389/1929658185?refcode=em_fl_eha_20240914_fr_apachers_cand_mf_30da_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTZmZjRkNS05ZTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lKVEI2bMnLtj7DeaF5afpZ03WHZMG2BxRys-zEtjrMM=)**

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkcuK4zAQRb9G3tnIVUocLbwIuM0s-jF0D8xSyFIlFuhhJLmH_vshPckHzLZucesc6veLetHOu3h91YHGi88qFxW1Wp33pTW5tmXPn21ZU64KOIiWy7YXChs78l5aIRoa-wGOCIM8DM060gHxtBghUXOUPYeen_hwsnq4LIvEpXHjrYfLXvQojodThxLkgNxozQEALBNce8q1u2Qim4KO1ruFcv3KtKVcO5NC48e11q0wPDOYGcwuXlL3TW21p47szmB-8NPXbQnnYhhOvD8M8MpBwDM_T2_T09MHg-Negyppz4YYTltOZSNTXbzeo0DW7YHhREE7fx8aHTbtrpHhZHJ9HPoXpVgpVobTx4-391_q57mdn9_bh3mTR7v9cd67chyY4Ndb67dX_a8nfI7wNwAA__-yzZAp)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkcuK4zAQRb9G3tnIVUocLbwIuM0s-jF0D8xSyFIlFuhhJLmH_vshPckHzLZucesc6veLetHOu3h91YHGi88qFxW1Wp33pTW5tmXPn21ZU64KOIiWy7YXChs78l5aIRoa-wGOCIM8DM060gHxtBghUXOUPYeen_hwsnq4LIvEpXHjrYfLXvQojodThxLkgNxozQEALBNce8q1u2Qim4KO1ruFcv3KtKVcO5NC48e11q0wPDOYGcwuXlL3TW21p47szmB-8NPXbQnnYhhOvD8M8MpBwDM_T2_T09MHg-Negyppz4YYTltOZSNTXbzeo0DW7YHhREE7fx8aHTbtrpHhZHJ9HPoXpVgpVobTx4-391_q57mdn9_bh3mTR7v9cd67chyY4Ndb67dX_a8nfI7wNwAA__-yzZAp)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01

name: LCV Membership Team
subject: Tell Congress: Defend Our Climate from Polluter-pushed Rollbacks
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE1MDgyNzES1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjA2MDMwMDQzOQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter: https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/3Z0ec- Tell Congress to

Expand the Supreme Court

to Stop MAGA Judges’ Relentless Power Grab After the recent decisions in Trump v. United States, Ohio v. EPA, and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo, grassroots activists around the country are calling for action to stop the
MAGA Justices’ power grab on behalf of far-right special interests, which will
have devastating consequences for our environment and health.

Congress has the authority to hold the Supreme Court accountable and to set the
number of Justices on the Court. It’s past time for lawmakers to expand and rebalance the Court — help us deliver 10,000 signatures calling for immediate action. https://links.messages.lcv. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_ Peter — the MAGA Justices on the captured Supreme Court just put Donald
Trump above the law and grabbed even more power to serve special interests at
the expense of Americans’ right to breathe clean air, to drink clean water, to
exercise a truly equal right to vote, and to make fundamental reproductive
health decisions. This week, shockingly the MAGA Supreme Court granted immunity in Trump vs. the United Statesand put our very democracy at risk because for democracy to endure, no one –
especially not the president – can be above the law. In Ohio v. EPA and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo, they made it even harder for scientists and experts at agencies like the EPA
to protect the air we breathe and the water we drink — and even easier for
billionaires and corporate interests like Big Oil to get their way. Billionaires
and corporations have showered MAGA Justices on the Supreme Court with luxury
gifts and travel, and oil billionaire Charles Koch even backed some of the
lawyers who brought these anti-environment cases. Once again, those investments
paid off. Peter — for the sake of our communities, our democracy and our planet,
it’s past time to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. Sign our petition to Congress right now. It only takes a moment to help us reach our 10,000 signature goal >> https://links.messages.lcv. Adding seats to the Supreme Court would allow the president to appoint new
justices who will work for the people, not deep-pocketed polluters and MAGA
extremists. Following the news, there has been a groundswell of grassroots
activism around the country — an outcry for change on the Court. Today, we’re calling on all LCV members to submit a message to their lawmakers in
Congress in support of the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme
Court.We need to raise pressure for action now, before the MAGA Justices cause even
more damage to our health, our freedoms, and our planet. Tell Congress: Pass the Judiciary Act to expand the Supreme Court. You have the authority. It’s past time to act. We’re aiming to submit 10,000 letters before the end of the month. https://links.messages.lcv. Protections for our environment, our reproductive rights, our equality, and our
democracy are only as strong as the judges who uphold them. We have to stand up
for our rights to breathe clean air and drink clean water, have our votes
counted, make our own health decisions, and more. Thank you for speaking out today, Peter. We’ll be in touch soon with
more updates on our campaigns. Onward, Doug Lindner
Senior Director of Judiciary & Democracy
