body:
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)
Hey Peter, born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.
**The stakes are high this election year — especially in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race.** Here we’ve got Josh Hawley, the coward of January 6th, up against Lucas Kunce, a 13-year Marine veteran who knows what it’s like to grow up through hardship, fight for his community, and serve our country.
I’m proud to support Lucas, and in a moment I’ll ask you to join me. But first, I want to tell you why I know that Lucas can defeat Hawley this year and why his grassroots campaign urgently needs our help. **Please let me explain.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)**
I’ll be honest: I’ve been ready to defeat Josh Hawley since January 6th, 2021.
He totally disgraced my home state that day... raising his fist because he wanted to look strong, and then running away like a little coward out the back door.
**But Josh Hawley has done a lot more than just that to embarrass Missouri over the years, stuff you probably wouldn’t even believe.**
Hawley himself played a major role in overturning Roe V. Wade — he even bragged about it! He backs the total abortion ban in Missouri, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, and is a pioneer of the legal movement threatening access to IVF and birth control nationwide.
Hawley forced Missouri taxpayers to cover his legal bills after he broke the law — $250,000, in this economy! He’s refused to invest a single dollar in Missouri, instead spending all his time writing stuff like his “Manhood” self-help book.
It’s just shameful.
**[CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)**
**Now let’s talk about Lucas Kunce.** I learned about Lucas probably the same way many of you did, from online ads and emails just like this one.
I heard Lucas’ story of struggle and community, which reminded me of my own. I’m sure it resonates with you too. I also saw he was running a real campaign — outraising Hawley, earning record-breaking support, bringing people together regardless of what party they’re from or who they’ve voted for before.
And I saw it’s made the polls get closer, too.
I’m all-in to help Lucas because I know he can win this race. I know Missouri can elect a Senator we can all be proud of. And I know if we all pitch in, we can run that coward Josh Hawley out of the Senate!
**I’m about to get to the most important part of this email, but first I need to ask:[Will you please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley by donating $10 or more to his grassroots campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71610?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=5&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71610?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=6&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)
---
I want you to take what I’m about to tell you seriously, Peter.
**With so much on the line this year, Missouri’s U.S. Senate race is one of the most important in America — one of our ONLY chances to flip a GOP-held seat.**
**First off, Josh Hawley is far more vulnerable than any national news outlet will lead you to believe.** Hawley won his last election with only 51% of the vote, with a margin weaker than Trump’s by double digits. Since then, polls consistently show he’s the least popular GOP Senator up for re-election this cycle, with approval ratings even lower than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida.
Maybe even more telling than all that... after January 6th, Hawley’s former mentor, three-term Missouri Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth said supporting Hawley’s campaign in 2018 was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
Hawley’s base abandoned him. And he hasn’t won them back.
**[CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)**
**Meanwhile, Lucas has consistently played offense** — holding Hawley accountable for his extreme record while getting his own positive message of taking back power for working people in front of voters across Missouri.
He’s earned critical support from Missouri’s election-winning labor movement, groups like Abortion Action Missouri, Social Security Works, and End Citizens United — and even the Missouri Fire Fighters, who normally endorse Republicans. **With help from real people like you, all across the country, he’s built a record-breaking movement to flip this Senate seat.**
Frankly, Peter, Lucas Kunce and Missouri’s U.S. Senate race haven’t got the attention they deserve this year. But that’s OK, because it hasn’t changed this truth:
**Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley if he has the resources to make it happen.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)**
Time isn't on our side here. November 5th will be here before we know it, and we’ve gotta make every moment count for Lucas and the team.
We’ve gotta make sure they have the resources to fight back hard against the onslaught of attacks that have already started from Hawley and his campaign.
Oh yeah, I forgot to mention — _Hawley is so afraid of Lucas, he hasn’t even run a single ad about his own record in the Senate._ It’s all just false attack ads against Lucas!
**If you’re able to support Lucas right now in this important moment, you can make a real difference for our country this year, Peter.** So I’m personally asking:
**[Will you please join me in supporting Lucas’ campaign by donating $10, $25, or just whatever you can today? Lucas is committed to running his campaign the right way, without a single cent from corporate PACs, so anything you’re able to give really will make a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71610?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71610?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71610?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71610?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71610?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71610?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71609?refcode=em20240914-7656&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)
---
Thank you for listening,
John Goodman
Born-and-raised Missourian

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lk-email-footer?refcode=em20240914-7656-footer&t=18&refcode2=7656_614464_GFpH1f&akid=7656%2E614464%2EGFpH1f)**

| | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. Our union was nearly torn apart by the great evil of slavery – 620,000 soldiers fell during the Civil War. Yet the star spangled banner still waved over the land of the free and the home of the brave. America ended two World Wars, demolished the Soviet Union, and stands today as a shining city on a hill to which the whole world looks for leadership and guidance. Through it all, the beautiful scars America has developed are proof that our country is the greatest, most benevolent, and freest nation in the history of mankind. It’s to that country, and the people who she represents, I have pledged my life, my service, my body, mind, and soul. As long as there is breath in my lungs and blood flowing through my veins, I will never stop fighting to make sure that America’s future is bright and beautiful. And I’d be honored beyond explanation to receive your support in my mission to continue my service to America as the next United States Senator from Nevada. **_[With the heart of a dedicated veteran and servant to our country I have a request for you:](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=46084a35faef4aa1bda12f611bdef137&_e=MhY9WZeoZmPZkeJLReiQ-wQ6afVK347qS0hB8z_oSjXHUcPKMGnsS0sha1XW2-S5bNxlm6b1qHGI3IyJNiqqj4lo0Hv2h9qtXVf3Uc9VfPUE44oh3apf9C6LaJteNwFsyvJqm7C_IMZ12oR8d-lcZn9g9KcLnz1HGrndQ1odrnrjtYVWzx3w4A5L65mHa1BdmUS4nBAAElglzSyaRVhsbH_PpX8mrkPQsdOx6l11GL_vOKWvOR8286ZWfxAv8lzkStw4x7RNzFest0Xx9sJRBf-mvJMJKbIagDEuzeeDC_lF4gjax66hy-Jvi_vHC_tIFVtc8vhoINAFDem2LQ6-mcSruBVsr_8g7f0uxOjzo3OVwwcr0ocQOpunVGL7YMpOc6fS8zXR994yAvMlibl5ViHT5L9NKNEFlys7_9NlEIxfPFZ995ZBVXQj-JGQRxPf1PlJlIJ6-bws7t1XWDhTpFetbDdEea4nGT-Kwtjm6Iw%3D) _** _**[_**Would you consider supporting my mission today?**_](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=46084a35faef4aa1bda12f611bdef137&_e=MhY9WZeoZmPZkeJLReiQ-wQ6afVK347qS0hB8z_oSjXHUcPKMGnsS0sha1XW2-S5bNxlm6b1qHGI3IyJNiqqj4lo0Hv2h9qtXVf3Uc9VfPUE44oh3apf9C6LaJteNwFsyvJqm7C_IMZ12oR8d-lcZn9g9KcLnz1HGrndQ1odrnrjtYVWzx3w4A5L65mHa1BdmUS4nBAAElglzSyaRVhsbH_PpX8mrkPQsdOx6l11GL_vOKWvOR8286ZWfxAv8lzkStw4x7RNzFest0Xx9sJRBf-mvJMJKbIagDEuzeeDC_lF4gjax66hy-Jvi_vHC_tIFVtc8vhoINAFDem2LQ6-mc5_MmJPAsA-oi68W_E-ltIDqLHbynw7smcjnysc_fY2yuaqtSfbab5_KyZCDU690UxETr3_StGWsal8F6Kg29hrRqWoT432jpOnUgJuylrEgwBwI0qavP0Y2O-LXn7Y4psNRPS8iRe-nuNdgQX8MI4%3D)**_ Duty First, Captain Sam Brown

I also commemorated the 23rd anniversary of the 9/11 terrorist attacks and highlighted the disturbing revelations detailed in the Republican investigation into the Afghanistan withdrawal.
As always, thank you for your continued support of my campaign. We are less than two months until this critical election, and I’m going to be spending my time, energy, and resources working to make sure we hold onto our majority in the House of Representatives. If you’re able to donate anything at all to my campaign, it will go a long way toward ensuring conservatives win up and down the ballot this November. | A DEBATE THAT CHANGED NOTHING
---
| |
---
| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01J7RGMVZASMJ3PFXA4AWXHKTK_2)
---
| This week’s debate is past us, and no minds were changed. President Trump has indicated that he won’t do another debate, but I think he could easily win any debate against Kamala Harris.
Harris is all over the map on policy, but one fact remains unchanged: she has been at the highest levels of power over the last 3.5 years and supported every single progressive policy that has led to disastrous outcomes. This is not a matter of interpretation, but a matter of fact.
Harris is responsible for sky-high inflation - she cast the deciding vote on trillions in new spending that led to the worst inflation America has seen in decades. Harris is responsible for the illegal immigration crisis - as a candidate she promised to decriminalize border crossings and encourage policies that incentivize illegal immigration, which is exactly what she did as Border Czar. Harris was the last person in the room before Joe Biden made the disastrous decision to withdraw from Afghanistan, costing 13 American lives and destroying America’s credibility on the world stage.
Trump should take Harris up on a second debate and hone in on contrasting his four years in office to hers.
It’s an easy comparison. Trump should do that, and win.

| WHY WERE PEOPLE PROMOTED AFTER THE AFGHANISTAN WITHDRAWAL?
---
| |
---
| [**CLICK HERE TO READ MY TWEET THREAD**](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01J7RGMVZASMJ3PFXA4AWXHKTK_11)
---
| House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Michael McCaul released a damning report on the Biden-Harris Administration’s disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan. The report confirms what we already knew - that Joe Biden ignored the advice of military leaders about the risk of evacuating Afghanistan the way they did, and instead followed the lead of the State Department that had zero plan for the evacuation. Their failure led to the deaths of 13 Americans and destroyed America’s credibility on the world stage, which likely led our adversaries to believe they could take advantage of our weakness elsewhere.
I lay out all of the most disturbing elements of the report in my tweet thread, linked above.
One stunning revelation detailed in the report is the total lack of accountability in the aftermath of the disaster. In fact, key staff who were involved in the decision-making were actually promoted after the withdrawal.
Derek Chollet was promoted to Chief of Staff at the Department of Defense, and John Kirby was moved to the White House as National Security Communications Advisor to spin the narrative around the withdrawal. Now, to make matters worse, Kamala Harris is asking for a promotion from the American people after saying she was “comfortable” with the administration’s evacuation plans after being the last person in the room with Joe Biden before the decision was made to leave the way they did.
This is the lack of accountability the American people hate about Washington, D.C. People involved in this abject, deadly failure should have been fired not promoted.
---
|
---
| 23 YEARS AFTER 9/11
---
| |
---
| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01J7RGMVZASMJ3PFXA4AWXHKTK_12)
---
| This week, on the 23rd anniversary of 9/11, I shared a documentary I participated in a few years back in which I interviewed a New York City firefighter who responded to the terrorist attacks that horrible day. It is worth the watch this weekend if you have time.
I was in high school in Bogota, Colombia when I heard the news that America was under attack 23 years ago. I had already committed to becoming a Navy SEAL when I was younger, but what I saw on the morning of September 11, 2001 changed the course of my life, my worldview, and the lives of many others. I joined the Navy, went to BUD/S, put on my Trident, and went to work taking the fight to America’s enemies in Iraq and Afghanistan to bring justice for the victims in New York, the Pentagon, and Shanksville.
But also so they could never bring the fight home to us again—that’s what was at stake. I served with many men and women. All were committed to our country and willing to lay down their lives for the American people. I am grateful for their service and sacrifice, especially those who never made it home. We must make an effort to remember the victims from that morning and the wars that followed, but most importantly, remember the feeling of unity we felt as we came together as a many for our one country. We need that now, and every day. Never Forget.

As the daughter of a public school teacher, I’ve seen firsthand the dedication and sacrifices they make every day to provide the best education for their students. Our teachers are essential to shaping the future and guiding the next generation. But too often, they’re undervalued, underpaid, and overworked.

That’s why I’m fighting in Congress to ensure that public schools get the funding they need, that our teachers are paid a fair wage, and that every child has access to a high-quality education, regardless of where they live.

Republicans, like my opponent, have sided with those who want to defund public schools and divert resources to private schools, leaving many children and teachers behind. We can’t let that happen.

name: Raenah Lindsey
subject: Join Jocelyn and Helen Hunt on 9/17 and let’s rally for democracy!
body:
Hi, West Michigan!
My name is Raenah, and I’m a proud West Michigander leading the Michigan Legacy PAC’s Democracy Defenders [https://www.demdefenders.org/] program.
In the spirit of democracy, I’m pleased to invite you to join me and the Progressive Women’s Alliance next Tuesday, September 17th for a Rally for Democracy! Enjoy refreshments and the company of fellow democracy advocates while hearing from Secretary Jocelyn Benson, Justice Kyra Bolden, Senate Majority Leader Winnie Brinks, and Academy Award winning actress Helen Hunt about the importance of defending democracy this election.
RSVP here [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd_-f-S_aWgkdyxqW8LJcb8g9WUilnFU1o0yLV7HygKDgldrg/viewform] , share the word with friends, and come prepared to celebrate and rally behind democracy. We hope to see you there!
Regards,
Raenah

name: John Avlon
subject: Revolt of the Reasonable
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
Friends,
This election is a revolt of the reasonable. We're tired of all the hyper-partisan polarization in our politics that never delivers a damn thing to help hardworking families.
Reasonable people across the political spectrum understand that we have to stop fighting and start fixing.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonrevolt1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonrevolt1]
Americans are good people. We believe in helping our neighbor, and it's time we start elevating the idea of the common good again. To do that, we just need common sense and problem-solving in Congress. We need to focus on what unites us, not what divides us.

This election is a time to step up as citizens, to strengthen our civic backbone, and to do our part to ensure that we're handing our nation to the next generation better than it was when handed to us.
Together, we can build a new kind of politics on the other side of these dark times. Because democracy depends on an assumption of good will among fellow citizens.
Together, we can solve the border crisis, restore the state and local tax deduction, expand the child tax credit, work with law enforcement to get illegal guns and fentanyl off our streets, and we can reclaim the American flag as a symbol that unites our nation because it belongs to every last one of us.

Those are the principles that will guide me if I’m elected to the US Congress. We deserve a government as good as our people.
My opponent, Nick LaLota, does whatever Donald Trump says. He's far too far right for our district and is too busy fighting for special interests instead of hardworking Suffolk County families. He acts like an internet troll rather than a responsible member of Congress.

So in November, help me show Nick LaLota the door. This campaign is picking up momentum by the day, and with about two months left until Election Day, we can’t afford to slow down.
I know we can win this seat, but not without your help. If you’re able, chip in to my campaign today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonrevolt1]
Thank you for fighting the good fight with me.
- John

Friend, my team just ran the numbers on Rick Scott's policy goals — **and I don't think it's a price any of us want to pay: **
* **$1,480:** That's how much more, on average, most middle class American families would owe under Rick Scott’s plan to raise taxes.

clean_body: | | | Peter, Thousands of you have taken our since the presidential debate on Tuesday. You can read more below about some of the results, but here’s the bottom line: Our members are more energized about the election now than at any other point this year. But enthusiasm doesn’t automatically translate to a win in November. With just over seven weeks to go, and early voting in some states starting in just a few days, we all need to triple down on expanding and sustaining this movement. That’s why we’ve set a goal of contacting SEVEN MILLION voters in swing states between now and Election Day to elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz and working families champions all the way down the ballot. Here’s a more detailed breakdown of our survey results, Peter: 63% of you said that this week’s debate left you feeling more excited about your choice for president. That’s compared to only 14% who said the same after the Biden-Trump debate in June. 90% of you said you plan to vote for Kamala Harris for president , the highest number we’ve seen in any survey since she entered the race. And 50% of you committed to getting more involved over the next seven weeks to help us win big in November — whether that’s through sending postcards to your friends and family, making calls and texts to voters in key states, knocking on doors in your area, or pitching in financially. Whether we end up winning or losing on November 5th will depend on a lot of things — including how much we are able to translate this enthusiasm into action. We cannot afford to become complacent and treat this campaign as a spectator sport — no matter what the polls say on any given day, and no matter how many more lies and outrageous comments Trump makes on social media or TV. Making a through the election — if you’re in a position to do so — will leave an even greater impact. And if you’re unable to give at this time, . **BREAKING FIRST IN NEWSWEEK:
Lucas Kunce Within Striking Distance of Josh Hawley"****
**Lucas Kunce (D) 46% | Josh Hawley 50%**
**Over just the last month, Lucas Kunce has cut Josh Hawley’s lead from double digits to just 4%._[Help us keep up this historic momentum by rushing $10, $25, or whatever you can to our campaign today >>>](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71779?refcode=em20240914-7663&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7663%2E614464%2EFU_CdB)_**

---
Peter,
After Missouri’s primary election last month, something started to shift in the U.S. Senate race between Josh Hawley and Marine veteran Lucas Kunce.
Hawley suddenly started attacking Lucas by name with a rant of lies — in his stump speech, on Twitter, on Fox News — anywhere he could. **_And then, less than 48 hours after Lucas officially won the nomination, Hawley’s campaign started spending millions of dollars to air false attacks about Lucas in their very first TV ads._**
**[FIGHT BACK: CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71779?refcode=em20240914-7663&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7663%2E614464%2EFU_CdB)**
You and me of course always knew Lucas, his message, and our people-powered coalition were a threat to Hawley. But this just isn’t how an incumbent — let alone an incumbent in a “red” state — usually handles a challenger.
But it seems that like us, Hawley and his allies have tuned out the pundits and recognized reality: That they should be afraid of Lucas and his movement.
So in the last month, Hawley spent nearly THREE MILLION DOLLARS on FOUR FALSE ATTACK ADS. Meanwhile, our ads have been focused on Lucas, his record of service, and his commitment to restoring our freedoms and investing in Missouri.
**And now just a month after both sides started TV ads, this poll shows our race has gone from double-digits to only a four-point gap.**
In campaigns, that’s what we call “movement”. It’s what happens when millions of voters start seeing TV ads and learn about the candidates and their messages. And despite Hawley’s lies, it’s clear our message is breaking through and setting us on a path to win this race.
But Hawley’s campaign must have seen the same thing in their own numbers...because now out of nowhere, a **billionaire-backed Super PAC has just placed ONE MILLION DOLLARS in ads against Lucas to start THIS WEEKEND.**
**So we’re asking:[Will you rush a donation of $10, $25, or just whatever you can today so we’ll have the resources to continue getting Lucas and his message in front of Missouri voters? Lucas doesn’t take a cent from corporate PACs, so your donation — no matter the amount — will seriously have a big impact on our grassroots campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71779?refcode=em20240914-7663&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7663%2E614464%2EFU_CdB)**

This fight is personal. The American Dream made Tony’s story possible. He refuses to sit on the sidelines while others struggle to achieve the same dream.

This fight is also high stakes. Joe Biden won the presidency because of Nebraska. Now, Tony’s fighting to finish what he started and flip this district blue. Tony is proud to be endorsed by Planned Parenthood, 314 Action, CHC Bold PAC, New Dems Action Fund, Dems Serve, IBEW, Nebraska AFL-CIO, Communication Workers of America, Voter Protection Project, JStreet, and over 40 local elected officials.

Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation that provides firefighters and their communities the protection they need**
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran-Owned small businesses**
* **Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation**
* **Passed a resolution affirming strong US support for Ukraine**
* **Passed legislation to support mental health for school children**

body:

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92816094/498395638/-1889358261?refcode=BLU_EM_CBC_2024-09-14_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTE5ZmUyNjItYjI3Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=j4nFwOfGnzg7d9Ywid-ySFoporcAMKfgaIwfH5dfhY0=)
---
| Peter,

Here in Upper and Northern Michigan, we know what it means to work hard - and I come from a line five generations back in our district of gritty, resilient people like my 92-year-old grandma.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92816096/498395640/-1889358261?refcode=BLU_EM_CBC_2024-09-14_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTE5ZmUyNjItYjI3Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=j4nFwOfGnzg7d9Ywid-ySFoporcAMKfgaIwfH5dfhY0=)
Don't be fooled by the knit cardigan sweater. She is one tough lady.

Granny’s not afraid to use a chainsaw. She got pecked by a rooster and took care of it with her bare hands, saying, "Looks like dinner." And on her 60th birthday, she singlehandedly shingled the roof on the hunting camp cabin.

MAKE AMERICA HEALTHY
They Don’t Care About Your Health
Dear Peter,
You believe in giving your children and grandchildren healthy food...the best medicine...and a clean, safe environment in which they can thrive.
But the indifference shown by Big Ag and Big Pharma, and multiple US government “health” agencies to address critical issues we deeply care about say one thing loud and clear:
We Don’t Care About Your Health!
And the result of the coverups and willful unresponsiveness is in: **American children have more chronic diseases, are more obese, and are less healthy than at any other time in our nation’s history.**
You and I agree: This must end.
When you joined Team Kennedy, you did so to call out the corruption in our nation’s health and food sectors, both severely compromised by profits, needless pills, dubious studies, and multiple Special Interest organizations in Washington.
Thanks to your support, our grassroots movement boasts over a million Americans committed to cleaning the house and to...
Make America Healthy Again!
Our most significant opportunity to hold Big Ag, Big Pharma, and Big Government accountable is for individuals, like Bobby Kennedy, to have a key role in a Trump Administration committed to stamping out the corporate capture of our nation’s health agencies.
[Your voice and financial support will continue to beat the drum to keep your and your children’s health front and center on the political stage. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=they_dont_care_9_13_24_nd1&n=5)
President Trump, to his credit, was the only one in the Presidential race to call on RFK Jr. in order to enlist his direct support to Make America Healthy Again.
This is the **BIGGEST MOMENT** for Team Kennedy and RFK Jr., and we are calling on your continued support to grow our movement up to and beyond Election Day on November 5, 2024.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=they_dont_care_9_13_24_nd1&n=6)
[Please give now](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=they_dont_care_9_13_24_nd1&n=7) and support our new initiative to hold the government health agencies accountable to you, to investigate Big Pharma and Big Ag., and to prioritize the health of all Americans.
We can do better. Together we will.
Team Kennedy

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

Trump-appointed Postmaster General Louis DeJoy is running USPS into the
ground.

Since DeJoy took over USPS in 2020, he’s set it on a disastrous path to
privatization that’s caused mail delivery to slow and prices to skyrocket.
And he’s just released an outrageous new plan to reduce rural mail service
EVEN MORE.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19494?source=email-fire-dejoy-09142024&t=1011&akid=6783%2E5885482%2E92J1Yi ]Bernie’s been shouting from the rooftops for years that DeJoy has got
to go, and this latest move makes it clear we have to act now. Will you
stand with Bernie and call on the USPS Board of Governors to fire DeJoy,
before it’s too late to save the postal service?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19494?source=email-fire-dejoy-09142024&t=1012&akid=6783%2E5885482%2E92J1Yi ]ADD YOUR NAME

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19494?t=1013&akid=6783%2E5885482%2E92J1Yi ][IMG]

Louis DeJoy is the first postmaster general in two decades with NO prior
USPS experience, and it’s no secret why he got the job – he’s a Republican
mega-donor who wrote massive checks to Trump.

DeJoy has tried to run USPS like a for-profit company, jacking up prices,
closing down essential locations, and slashing hours for rural employees.
Now all of us are paying the price as we experience delays on everything
from prescription drugs to social security checks to passports.

USPS is a vital public service that we have to be able to rely on to
deliver essential mail on time. It’s especially important for rural and
indigenous communities where for-profit companies refuse to do business
because they don’t make enough of a profit. And as millions of Americans
vote by mail in the coming weeks, delays or lost ballots could be
disastrous.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19494?source=email-fire-dejoy-09142024&t=1014&akid=6783%2E5885482%2E92J1Yi ]DeJoy’s plan to privatize this essential public service must be
stopped. And the USPS Board of Governors is the only body with the power
to fire him. Will you stand with Bernie and join the urgent call to fire
DeJoy NOW?

Earlier this year, Bernie and 30 other Democratic Senators sent a letter
to DeJoy warning him to change course and stop USPS changes or closures
that would result in job losses and slower mail. Then Republicans even
started raising concerns as their constituents reported major delays.

In July, the Postal Service Board of Governors joined in, calling on DeJoy
to halt his disastrous plan to shrink the post office. But he plowed ahead
anyway, daring to announce even MORE cuts that will slow rural mail
delivery even more.

It couldn’t be clearer that DeJoy won’t stop unless he’s removed – so
let’s overwhelm USPS’s board with calls to fire DeJoy and save USPS.

When we organize, we win.

| | Firefighters know something about ladders. And I just love the story Val Hoyle told me about what her dad – a union firefighter – would say: **"Work hard and hold the ladder for the next guy."** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92820106/498407670/482805996?refcode=2024-09-14-hoyle&recurring=&amount=13&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=5aec8b8b-b872-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YWVjOGI4Yi1iODcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O0gL-_uqh-d7w57STTxaBPKERyzTF9m1EpvnUHqkWM4=) Thankfully for all of us, Val has been living those values her whole life. First, alongside her dad, who took her to her first picket line at age 6. Then later, as a working mom, when she raised two kids while earning minimum wage as a waitress. And she brought those same values to the Oregon legislature, to her time as Oregon's Labor Commissioner — and now to Washington, D.C., where she represents OR-4 in Congress. Friend, yesterday was Friday the 13th. It's often associated with bad luck and horror movies, and it got us thinking... Thinking about the **_horrifying_** things that John "Careerist" Curtis supports and advocates for, like the MAGA agenda and his **_"good luck,"_** which most people don't have, in the stock market.
[**Before we ask you to chip in $13 to mark the occasion,**](https://cg4ut.us/l/eBznqOHPYAp7) we have to be honest—we think about this every day, not just on Friday the 13th. Because Utah deserves better than another career politician in the U.S. Senate.
---
| [ ](https://cg4ut.us/l/htWhyruUjsS1)
---
Friend, our opponent's voting record already shows that working Utahns aren't his priority, but by lending his ear to the special interest groups that bankroll his campaign and siding with Trump on countless issues—we know that things can get even worse for Utahns. **_Housing prices, low wages, and corporate greed don't come from "bad luck" but are the result of bad policy._****__** While Utahns feel the brunt of these issues, our opponent is happy to be cashing in on his "good luck" streak from not breaking any mirrors 🪞 or walking under ladders 🪜. _**A streak which he doesn't want to end,**_ telling the New York Times in regards to financial transparency amongst elected officials, _"I hope that path doesn’t ban members of Congress, their families and staff from the same bedrock investment tools that are used by 145 million Americans.”_ One of Caroline's earliest campaign positions was to ban members of Congress from trading stocks. By dealing with sensitive information almost daily, it is nearly impossible for Congress members to not use it to inform their trades. **It's time for Curtis' "good luck" streak to end.** [**Friend, we aren't going to let the Right's efforts to push their agenda onto Utahns frighten us. Instead, we're dialing up our efforts to win against our careerist opponent and elect a real leader to the U.S. Senate this November. Can you chip in $13 or what you can to help us on this journey and make a difference?**](https://cg4ut.us/l/MDRMDM3zL9ZL)

| | Peter, Kevin Cramer can taste how close we are to defeating him – and he’s panicking. I just learned that he launched his very first radio ads in a desperate attempt to cling to his seat. [**But I have a plan to make his ads completely BACKFIRE.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92822552/498415337/-1408912288?amount=15&refcode=20240914_em_fr_b1_katrina_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTgyNTliMjQtYmQ3Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SrMBarVhHsGKijfXaAAZPadP01wo2Ugm38hzqcz_QXw=) I refuse to let my extremist opponent spread vicious lies to take this Senate seat from us – so I just released my own radio ads to fight back. [**_Right now, Kevin Cramer has raised over $2 MILLION to distort his record, attack me, and sabotage our plans to flip this state for Democrats. But I’ve got something even better. I have a fierce group of loyal supporters like you, Peter, who’ve got my back through thick and thin. clean_body: | = Hey, After this week’s debate, all eyes are on the race for the White House between Donald Trump and Kamala Harris. But, today I want to talk to you about some elections happening in our state that are equally as important, but get a fraction of the airtime, and those are races at the local and county level. Why do these races matter? Because all politics is local. Across the country we’ve seen reports of school boards banning books or removing curriculum material, county judges deciding cases that change policy as we know it, and county boards voting on affordable housing and transportation laws in our communities. There is a lot of damage that can be done at the local and county level – and thousands of our neighbors have been impacted by bad policy. That’s why it’s our job to fight back and ensure that Democrats are elected up and down the ballot. Luckily here in our state, the Illinois Democratic County Chairs’ Association is waging that battle – and they work every single day to make sure that every election is competitive, from the top of the ballot to the bottom. | Tracy and I finished up a long day on the campaign trail that included a stop in Lynchburg to visit to Monument Terrace. On September 11th, we honor the heroes we lost and the courage they showed 23 years ago. Freedom isn't free. We have been to too many funerals since. For those killed on 9/11 and the soldiers who have fought the battle ever since that day and lost their lives, we remember them always. Sadly, today we are more likely than not to have another terrorist attack. We pray God will protect our country and the American people. Where were you on 9/11/2001? Stay vigilant, let's keep an eye on each other, and again let's never forget!

name: Sherrod Brown
subject: I’m losing ground
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Sherrod Brown is running for re-election to the Senate in 2024, and we’re working to support him. I hope you’ll read the message below from him, and [**consider splitting a donation between Sherrod's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sherrod-brown.a43gKG&refcode=em240914-1-30&t=1&akid=5877%2E6688874%2EhPUjgs)
---

folks, Sherrod Brown here with an important update:
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sherrod-brown.a43gKG&refcode=em240914-1-30&t=2&akid=5877%2E6688874%2EhPUjgs)
**A brand new poll shows that I’m losing ground to my GOP opponent in the most expensive Senate race in the country.**
My megamillionaire Republican opponent is gaining traction in Ohio — _and fast_.
First, he self-funded $4.5 MILLION to his campaign. Then, Mitch McConnell’s super PACs made their biggest ad buy ever to plaster the airwaves in Ohio with attacks against me. **Now, we’re being outspent nearly 2 to 1 by outside special interest groups and my opponent is closing the gap.**

Peter,

The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. _**“Montana Senator Jon Tester has been a political unicorn for nearly two decades, but in a presidential year with an even more polarized electorate, he is now the underdog heading into the race's final stretch.”**_

Peter,

_**This is HUGE NEWS.**_

We have momentum and opportunity on our side. Peter,

The stakes in Ohio have never been higher.

My friend **Bernie Moreno** is running to defeat **Sherrod Brown** — a liberal who has stood in the way of putting America First for far too long.

Donald Trump made a lot of frankly unhinged claims during the debate the other night, but there’s one thing we can’t stop thinking about... When Trump was asked about his role in overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , he made an argument politicians frequently repeat: _He didn’t take away abortion rights. He just left it to the _states_ to decide._ **Trump and his far-right allies are well aware that Republican control over state legislatures gives them the opportunity to further their national goals while _seeming_ to keep their hands clean.** Their next target? State-level climate protections... but we can fight back. **[We’re stepping in to elect state-level champions who will take bold action for our planet, our democracy, and our future. Will you chip in toward our $70,000 end-of-quarter goal to help us keep up the fight?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92827869/498433026/2105508926?refcode=ea.342d26d0-cb72-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.342d26d0-cb72-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0MmQyNmQwLWNiNzItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=IPrfjArHdi12TH-4vsuLonxb5kNSUyEkKBuYsqmCUt8=)** **The good news is that there _are_ some states stepping up on critical issues when the federal government won’t.** Take gun violence prevention, for example. While Congress stalls, states like New York have passed stronger gun safety laws than anything we’ve seen from Washington. On climate policy, California is setting a national example by aggressively phasing out gas-powered vehicles and prohibiting new oil wells from drilling near sensitive areas like homes and schools. These transformative policies are coming from state legislatures, where the real fight for our climate future is unfolding. But here’s the problem: **Republicans spent the last two decades quietly taking control of statehouses while no one else was paying attention.** During the Obama presidency alone, Republicans flipped nearly 1,000 state legislative seats and governor offices. They used that power to strip away reproductive rights, gut environmental protections, and give corporate interests free rein. Now they’re gearing up to flip even more seats and double down on their self-serving agenda. But we’re not asleep at the wheel anymore. At JanePAC, we’re building climate caucuses in statehouses around the country that are ready to take bold action when Congress won’t. We’re backing candidates in **California, Arizona, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Colorado,** and **Texas** to challenge fossil fuel interests and secure climate action where it matters most. **[This is a rallying call for all of us to take action. Together, we can stop the GOP’s reckless agenda at the state level and elect leaders who will protect our environment and our rights. clean_body: (For better or worse) | Donald Trump made a lot of frankly unhinged claims during the debate the other night, but there’s one thing we can’t stop thinking about... When Trump was asked about his role in overturning Roe v. Wade , he made an argument politicians frequently repeat: He didn’t take away abortion rights. He just left it to the states to decide. Trump and his far-right allies are well aware that Republican control over state legislatures gives them the opportunity to further their national goals while seeming to keep their hands clean. Their next target? State-level climate protections... but we can fight back. = The good news is that there are some states stepping up on critical issues when the federal government won’t. Take gun violence prevention, for example. While Congress stalls, states like New York have passed stronger gun safety laws than anything we’ve seen from Washington. On climate policy, California is setting a national example by aggressively phasing out gas-powered vehicles and prohibiting new oil wells from drilling near sensitive areas like homes and schools. These transformative policies are coming from state legislatures, where the real fight for our climate future is unfolding. But here’s the problem: Republicans spent the last two decades quietly taking control of statehouses while no one else was paying attention. During the Obama presidency alone, Republicans flipped nearly 1,000 state legislative seats and governor offices. They used that power to strip away reproductive rights, gut environmental protections, and give corporate interests free rein. Now they’re gearing up to flip even more seats and double down on their self-serving agenda. But we’re not asleep at the wheel anymore. At JanePAC, we’re building climate caucuses in statehouses around the country that are ready to take bold action when Congress won’t. Team —
My name is Pat Ryan, and I have the tremendous honor of representing New York’s Hudson Valley in Congress. I attended West Point (located here in my district!), where I learned the values of duty, honor, and country.
I first swore an oath to defend this country from all enemies — foreign and domestic — at West Point nearly 20 years ago. I fought to protect freedom abroad; now, I am fighting every day to protect it at home.
For me, freedom isn’t a political bargaining chip or a cheap slogan. It’s the guiding principle of our nation and a set of ideals I risked my life to defend.
Like a woman’s right to control her own body without government interference. Or a child’s right to go to school without the fear of being hit by a stray bullet. Or every American’s right to breathe clean air or to drink clean water.
I’m fighting every single day to protect our freedoms in Congress, and today, I’m hoping you will chip in $5 or more to Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign so we can keep up the hard work to protect our freedoms. [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_pryan?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]

Then, we proved them wrong again by winning a toss-up race in November. We did it because we pulled no punches, met voters where they were, and spoke plainly about the issues that matter. We spoke about freedom.
Now, we need to win back the Democratic House majority, and there’s no place more important in that task than New York.
Your support now will set us up for success for years to come. Building a sustainable, high-performing campaign in New York and beyond takes a lot of resources. That’s why I’m asking:
Please , can I count on you to pitch to me and Kirsten Gillibrand and keep up the good fight for freedom, for New York, and for our country? [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_pryan?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]

Pat Ryan

[](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=836129ba27ab4a3693a3f42f29bf1007&_e=qVuJpF-i834bpEbHxZ6ndqWi8ZPlNtKVIF-ByvmO0z4yr12N0gzKk5kwlro4NJtSREhfjEH-jHbC-A4FHI0ee3_TQRtiDutl7oFi1D5_lpLoy61sLbjdf47BVC3PVEX0moFQoeRFTIjJKvsQbvTovvnBU5BzrPffL9Hq2NBePZGDAi7TxXPzz9edg4wb8TPkzVHyENSaZH472V7zMDHyokv4_OJQJHPL7G6fPMPLIHJvPV2e2f2K5wWYHl3lb2gCXPRR52e2oeY9WFwauwEhXMOT13dqXSP5r3rP3VKqtyR018_uTZ0G-K6qd_ry0iRwP2b8zmVPb9N9_rbLUkBCXsCxOi6t_lnBgnXMme5f0I-k3B0ttXOXy_hw67bv1gpHjD6img5pGRvhnv-1Wea6xycOYXQ4VnTvjE_YZhpb8i8%3D) Dear Fellow American, Thanks for opening my email. I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=836129ba27ab4a3693a3f42f29bf1007&_e=qVuJpF-i834bpEbHxZ6ndqWi8ZPlNtKVIF-ByvmO0z4yr12N0gzKk5kwlro4NJtSREhfjEH-jHbC-A4FHI0ee3_TQRtiDutl7oFi1D5_lpLoy61sLbjdf47BVC3PVEX0moFQoeRFTIjJKvsQbvTovvnBU5BzrPffL9Hq2NBePZGDAi7TxXPzz9edg4wb8TPkzVHyENSaZH472V7zMDHyokv4_OJQJHPL7G6fPMPLIHJvPV2e2f2K5wWYHl3lb2gCXPRR52e2oeY9WFwauwEhXFHvxmN-j5e3ARLN1td0CBJkJdZKJ_N37PJbDeAcAjCFBa6Ksy9hjxyjNnJI4pwRgmhZUwWWLhLGmlvGFEiuZf_RZz48EHvU-Ychpj6rxzctJE2yZXxHW4AUM2MFjxJnWVSe7NNVPFtHgZQHip4JvMQ%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. But Kari Lake has used lies and conspiracies around January 6th to elevate her candidacy and build credibility with the far-right and Trump’s MAGA supporters.
That’s why I am personally writing to ask for your help, to send a message that we cannot allow insurrectionist-cheerleaders to get into the United States Senate.

# **VP Pick is JD Vance: A Threat to Democracy**
---
| | | | | [ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2urr0b-ewybmj-kyd76rh0/)
---
| | | | This is big news, folks, Ever since JD Vance was selected to be Trump's running mate, there has been more on the line in this election than ever before. This choice goes beyond mere campaign strategy and tactics, raising critical questions about the future direction of the country. Vance is an election denier who has switched his position on numerous key issues, proving he cannot be trusted with the office of Vice President. JD Vance's political evolution has been marked by a dramatic shift from initial criticism of Trump to becoming one of his most ardent supporters. In 2016, Vance referred to Trump as an “idiot,” “noxious,” and “reprehensible,” questioning whether Trump would be a “cynical a---- like Nixon” or “America’s Hitler.” Once Trump won the election, Vance quickly changed his tune. Vance has since embraced Trump's agenda wholeheartedly. He has articulated a vision for a radical transformation of American governance, suggesting that Trump should overhaul the civil service, replace existing bureaucrats with loyalists, and defy judicial constraints. Vance has proven time and time again that he is willing to pursue extreme measures to achieve his political goals. Vance's role in the Senate and his association with the "New Right," a group advocating for government intervention in cultural and economic matters to advance a right-wing agenda, show his radical agenda for what it is. Vance’s endorsement of foreign authoritarian figures, such as Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, further underscores his anti-democratic inclinations. Orbán’s control over media and educational institutions serves as a model for Vance’s vision of governance, wherein dissenting voices are suppressed, and power is centralized. This authoritarian admiration positions Vance as not merely a supporter of Trump’s ambitions but an active proponent of dismantling democratic institutions around the world. Knowing all of this, we can only imagine what Vance's course of action would have been if he was in Mike Pence's shoes on January 6th. Pence's refusal to support Trump's attempt to overturn the 2020 election was a critical moment in defending democratic norms. In contrast, Vance’s alignment with Trump’s most authoritarian impulses makes him a candidate who would not only comply with but actively pursue anti-democratic actions. JD Vance’s selection as Trump’s running mate is a significant threat to American democracy. [**_Vance poses a substantial threat to democracy. His vision of a government that aggressively pursues a right-wing agenda does not align with what voters around the country need in a Vice President. His presence on the ticket not only bolsters Trump’s chances but also significantly jeopardizes the democratic fabric of the United States. Stand with us in our fight to defeat these election deniers and defend democracy._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2urr0b-ewybmk-kyd76rh1/)

In a moment, we’re going to ask you to consider [**chipping in $5, $10, or anything you can, ahead of our final mid-month fundraising deadline of the quarter.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92828915/498437196/-235138218?refcode=em24_240914_nehd_fndd_gq_act___TC_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240914_nehd_fndd_gq_act___TC_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=9c9665ea-d372-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Yzk2NjVlYS1kMzcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=daSQob7vQhc5_VapMOkdzWgOKcCgimJjXt8uSR0UdJA=) _But first, we wanted to take a minute to explain why we’re asking for your hard-earned dollars:_

If there’s one thing we know about this race, it’s that the stakes couldn’t be higher.

Every day, it seems like we’re seeing a never-ending stream of new headlines talking about how critical this race is – **but we already know.**

We don’t need to tell you again that PA-08 has been rated the #1 most vulnerable seat in Pennsylvania, or that experts are calling us “a top target,” or how Republicans are pouring more dark money into this district than ever before. **We need to ACT.**

Look, Peter: this isn’t Matt’s first tough race. For years, Republicans have been trying to unseat him. But, thanks to the folks on this incredible grassroots team, Matt has always been able to fight back, win, and continue fighting for our best interests in Congress. Whether it’s standing up for working families, protecting Social Security and Medicare, or lowering the price of prescription drugs for seniors, Matt knows that there’s still work to be done – _and he’s ready to keep us moving forward._

The GOP has made it clear they don’t want someone in Congress who puts people over politics, and that’s why they’re coming after Matt harder than ever. We knew this fight was coming. We’ve seen these attacks before, and we’ve beaten them before – because we’ve got something that extreme Republicans don’t: a grassroots coalition that has Matt’s back. The power of this team has always been something special. It’s the folks like you who chip in $5, $10, or $25 who’ve helped Matt beat the odds time and time again.

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4183%2E552475%2Ev0GbOx)
I wanted to share an urgent update on this race with you, Peter.
**National Republicans are launching multiple _massive_ ad buys against me right as _a CNN poll shows that our race is tied._ **
[**I need everyone on board in order to fight back against this wave of spending. Will you pitch in $5 or more before our mid-month deadline tomorrow?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240914-3?refcode=em20240914-3&recurring=1&refcode2=4183_552475_v0GbOx&akid=4183%2E552475%2Ev0GbOx)
The GOP knows that the path to the Senate and the White House runs through Pennsylvania. That’s why they’re swooping in with just 52 days left to give David McCormick the final boost he needs to flip this battleground.
At this critical moment, we can’t afford to be drowned out on the airwaves. Everything, from defending against this surge of attacks to reaching undecided voters, will come down to the resources we do — or do not — have in these final few weeks.

Hi Peter,
Here’s a secret: in a race like this, it’s not just about convincing undecided voters to vote for us — it’s about making sure they know who we are in the first place.
Name recognition for congressional candidates is usually extremely low. That’s why it's so important to reach voters through ads, phone calls, door knocking — and with signs in every corner of the district.
Low name recognition can also make it easy for people like my opponent to hide who they really are.
From his anti-choice, anti-LGBTQ voting record to his deep involvement in a Christian nationalist group — my opponent has a lot he would rather voters in AZ-06 didn’t know.
I don’t have anything to hide. I’ve spent my career fighting for Arizona’s water security, public schools, veterans, and seniors, and that’s exactly what I’ll keep doing in Congress.
With just over 50 days until the election, voter outreach has never been more important. body:
| Peter, I know I’ve been sharing a lot of old photos recently, but I just had to send this to you.

Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92830946/498444005/-972566244?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20240914_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDBjZDg0Yi1kYzcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yBdrBDQJkQmhSW-OM3TGHq9EEI0CUZ5wCkbKRkr3afM=) I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith.

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause.

Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask — [will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to split between Ritchie Torres and my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92830948/498444007/-972566244?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20240914_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDBjZDg0Yi1kYzcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yBdrBDQJkQmhSW-OM3TGHq9EEI0CUZ5wCkbKRkr3afM=) If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.

We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.

This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)

While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.

**In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.**

These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.

And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.

That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

clean_body: | Peter, I know I’ve been sharing a lot of old photos recently, but I just had to send this to you. Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah: = I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith. Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause. Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask — = If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it. I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company. We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school. This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.) While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day. In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God. These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office. And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours. That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. Texas is truly the new capital of voter suppression, Team.
Texas A.G. Ken Paxton has now sued Travis County ( Austin ) and Bexar County ( San Antonio ) over their plans to try and register unregistered voters. The suits seek to stop officials in both counties from mailing voter registration applications to non-registered residents of those counties.
Paxton claims he's not done, either, and has threatened Harris County ( Houston ) by letter as they consider similar measures to increase voter participation.
Of course, these lawsuits come on the heels of the Governor announcing that Texans has purged over 1 million voters the last few years. These purges disenfranchise legitimate registered voters and these lawsuits seek to stop new voters from getting registered. It's legalized voter suppression, right in our faces.

Patriot,

I want to introduce myself. **My name is Pat Harrigan, and I’m a Trump-Endorsed Green Beret running for Congress in North Carolina’s 10th district.**

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=9d8dc7a50abf445b847d8b2b495aa68d&_e=VhSt2IgQTs_T7byTpxHn1iHGKmv0a4KEW2HbRm4EedlTdLJXMd550ej0dZSPXX1Ah0BqZ2NJVftFGQHlJAWX9_sysO1tdSx6ZLRdg0w5s4bVoh97cx-YBjUWCpfSIxskVnU0sj6b0-_qOdPN7b_tkHAGsK3p4bAmFRm2tJvI1-cyBNBR6cMgM4oKsHbSGqd3mueJG3a2iwzyiKbt9iHqq4jpSQzX9-kqD0OYWBw63EzYWIV_t_iuTRlwNazknY6Fpgz6p1st7Ff9sohjsHQ-meuWwzbuujI_SJ9EPFjEnBHFtRp0QSZTk19sJ4r9jZE7LjT9sjIuBZzLDSafuslULA%3D%3D)
I was born on the west coast and while growing up, split my time between San Diego and small-town Wyoming.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nv?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=9_14_scotus_resend&n=1)
---
Peter,
Yesterday we sent out some exciting ballot access updates that we wanted to make sure you didn't miss. First, we got the news that _**we WILL be on the ballot in Georgia**_. The Secretary of State wrote a letter confirming that we qualified - we beat another of the anti-democratic party’s attempts to kick Jill and Butch off the ballot!! The bad news is that a few days ago we had an update about Nevada, where the anti-democratic party is attempting yet again to undermine democracy by using all the dirty tricks they can. To summarize, in case you missed it, the Nevada Secretary of State, a Democrat, gave the campaign the wrong forms to use to get on the ballot. Then the dirty Dems used that technicality to sue us off the ballot - we won in lower courts, only to lose in the Nevada Supreme Court. Not surprisingly, our research team found that the Chief Justice in the case is a DNC donor. But we aren’t quitting our fight for ballot access in Nevada so millions of people in the silver state can have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action option in November. **_Our lawyers are filing a case to take the fight to the highest court in the land: US Supreme Court._** This is good news for ballot access across the country. Our campaign had planned to tackle the unfair signature and fee requirements that vary wildly state-by-state, but we hadn’t planned to be able to do so in the Supreme Court so soon. Depending on the outcome, this could mean Greens all over the country will be able to run for office more easily and could save millions in 2028\. We can’t miss the opportunity to rectify this waste of time and resources. Jill and Butch need you to pitch in today to take this fight to the US Supreme Court and pay our legal fees in Nevada. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
When union leaders try to meet with Jim Jordan, he doesn't even bother to face them.
Labor leaders have told us that he literally sneaks out the back door, blows them off to meet with his big money backers, or pawns them off to a 19 year old intern. Unsatisfactory!
Why does he do that?
Because Jordan is bought and paid for by right-wing corporate donors who want to profit off the backs of working people.
Contribute today to help us fight back against Jim Jordan’s anti-worker agenda. Your support will help us bring real leadership to Congress, leadership that fights for working people. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240914_unions_link1]
I vow to you right now, I WILL NEVER ignore my people!
Jordan’s legislative record speaks for itself.
He’s voted against expanding worker protections and consistently backed anti-union legislation over his 17 years in Congress.
He’s supported measures that undermine collective bargaining, weaken workplace safety standards, and block efforts to raise the minimum wage.
The list goes on and on.
Remember when Ohio was a beacon of industry?
For generations, Ohio was the heart of America’s manufacturing power.
From steel mills to auto plants, Ohio workers were the backbone of the U.S. economy, building everything from cars to machinery.
Union jobs provided strong wages, good benefits, and a pathway to the middle class.
But over the years, politicians like Jim Jordan have stood by while corporations slashed wages, cut jobs, and shipped factories overseas. We have lost several factories in the district and Jordan hasn’t done a damn thing to replace those jobs!
This has left Ohio workers to fend for themselves while corporate profits soar. Our state’s industrial glory has been gutted, and now, instead of rebuilding, Jordan continues to undermine workers' rights.
That’s the complete opposite of what I stand for.
When I was growing up, my dad worked as a contractor and he didn’t get the protections of a union. I saw how it impacted my family and the consequences of not having good benefits. My mom’s cancer went undetected for years, now she has stage 4 cancer. I don’t want any family to have to go through that.
I believe strong unions mean a strong middle class, and I’m committed to making it easier for workers to organize and join a union.
When workers have power, we all benefit—better wages, safer working conditions, and stronger communities.
With your help, we can turn the tide. I’m ready to expand worker protections, defend union rights, and rebuild Ohio’s middle class. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240914_unions_link2]
Chip in now, and let’s restore the dignity of work in Ohio. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240914_unions_link3]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

subject: I wish I did not have to ask
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1924%2E135344%2EBssjxX)

Friends --
I want to share something with you that I feel deeply about: I wish we didn't have to send these emails. It’s why it’s important to me that I write or edit _every_ email I send.
I wish we didn't have to ask for donations around FEC deadlines and monthly deadlines. I wish we didn't have to ask people almost daily for a few dollars at a time. I wish we didn't have to send text messages or run ads asking for donations.
But when we started this Senate campaign we made a choice -- and the choice was to reject corporate PAC money.
We made that decision knowing this Michigan Senate race will be one of the most expensive and competitive races in the country, and after having rejected it in all 3 of my competitive House races.
So we have to ask.
We have to ask because when lots donate at once, it adds up quick and ensures we have the resources to fight back.
So like I said, we have to ask. And that is especially important around these quarterly FEC fundraising deadlines -- the next of which is coming up fast. So please:
